bill_desc: Revises definition of term "autism spectrum disorder"; revises definition of term "eligible individual" to mean person of any age who has been diagnosed as having developmental disability for purpose of health care coverage under group, blanket, & franchise policies, health maintenance contracts, & under Medicaid program.

Revises circumstances under which securities transactions are exempt from registration requirements; revises filing requirements for securities issuers under Florida Invest Local Exemption law; revises requirements for securities registration applications; revises list of individuals who must submit fingerprints for live-scan processing for registration applications; revises written assurances requirements that merger & acquisition brokers must receive from certain control persons; revises circumstances under which merger & acquisition brokers are not exempt from specified securities registration; revises circumstances under which person is eligible for payment from Securities Guaranty Fund.

bill_title: Issuance of Address and Individual Parcel Identification Numbers
bill_desc: Requires appropriate governing body to issue, within specified time after recordation of plat, certain information; provides penalty.

bill_title: Purchase and Possession of Firearms by Law Enforcement Officers, Correctional Officers, Correctional Probation Officers, and Servicemembers
bill_desc: Specifies that correctional probation officers have right to carry concealed firearms during off-duty hours at discretion of superiors; authorizes correctional probation officers to perform certain law enforcement functions under limited circumstances; specifies that correctional probation officer's appointing or employing agency or department may limit officer from carrying concealed firearms during off-duty hours; revises exemptions from mandatory waiting period between purchase & delivery of firearm.

Revises provisions relating to invasion of trust principal, claims against former trustees, certain property transferred to donee during settlor's lifetime, community property, & community property trusts.
Prohibits discrimination based on protected hairstyle in K-20 public education system & specified private schools.

Requires that AHCA include specified requirements relating to care from, & reimbursement to, out-of-network Medicaid providers in agency's contracts with Medicaid managed care plans; authorizes enrollees of Medicaid managed care plans to receive care from Medicaid providers not under contract with plan; requires plans to reimburse such providers at applicable rates paid for such services under plan.

bill_title: Faith-based Content in Batterers' Intervention Programs
bill_desc: Specifies that batterers' intervention programs may include faith-based content; directs DCF to amend specified rule to conform.

bill_title: My Safe Florida Condominium Pilot Program
bill_desc: Prohibits condominium association from applying for hurricane mitigation inspection or mitigation grant under My Safe Florida Condominium Pilot Program unless certain association property or condominium property is established as common element & association has complied with specified requirements; revises approval requirements to receive mitigation grant; removes amount of grant funding for certain projects; revises improvements for which grant may be used; requires improvements to be identified in final hurricane mitigation inspection in order for association to receive grant funding.

bill_title: Deferred Retirement Option Program Eligibility for School Employees and Personnel
bill_desc: Removes the time limitation for DROP eligibility for certain personnel.

Provides exemption from public records requirements for specified personal identifying & location information of employees of crime stoppers organizations & board members & volunteers of such crime stoppers organizations; provides for future legislative review & repeal of exemption; provides for retroactive application; provides statement of public necessity.

Prohibits candidates, elected public officers, appointed public officers, & public employees from knowingly misrepresenting their Armed Forces of United States service records, awards, or qualifications or wearing any uniform, medal, or insignia that they are not authorized to wear; provides civil penalties; provides that certain penalties are delinquent if they aren't paid to Commission on Ethics within specified timeframe; requires Attorney General to attempt to determine whether individual owing certain penalties is current public officer or public employee; requires Attorney General to notify CFO or governing body of county, municipality, school district, or special district of total amount of any such penalty owed by current public officer or public employee; requires CFO or governing body to begin withholding portions of any salary-related payment that would otherwise be paid to officer or employee; requires that withheld payments be remitted to commission until penalty is satisfied; authorizes CFO or governing body to retain portion of each retained payment for administrative costs; authorizes Attorney General to refer certain unpaid fines to collection agency; authorizes collection agency to use any lawful collection method; authorizes Attorney General to collect unpaid fine within specified period after issuance of civil penalty or restitution penalty.

Authorizes counties & municipalities, respectively, to zone or designate parcel for single-family residential use or single-family hybrid housing use; authorizes counties & municipalities, respectively, to allow use of land for single-family residential use, while prohibiting use of land for single-family hybrid housing use; provides for adoption of local land development regulations.
Creates and revises provisions addressing certain domestic and foreign limited liability companies, series, and protected series, including registered series and protected series.

Revises definition of term "certified recovery residence"; requires credentialing entity to revoke certified residence's certificate of compliance if certified recovery residence willfully, knowingly, or intentionally provides false or misleading information to credentialing entity; revises applicability of provisions governing referrals to or from recovery residences.

Requires guardians of property to file quarterly, rather than annual, accounting reports by specified dates; authorizes court to set different quarterly schedule; requires guardian to mail copy of each quarterly accounting to ward's next of kin; requires first quarterly accounting period to end within certain timeframe after letters of guardianship are issued; requires guardians of property to file quarterly, rather than annual, accounting reports; requires guardian to mail copy of each quarterly accounting to ward's next of kin; authorizes certain guardians to file each monthly statement of ward's account from ward's financial institution for preceding quarter; requires court to appoint appraiser to appraise ward's property; requires all documentation, including bids submitted to purchase such property, from appraiser to be retained in court file; requires court to refer certain guardians to FDLE for criminal investigation.

Authorizes board of county commissioners & municipal governing body, respectively, to adopt ordinance for transitional housing; establishes eligibility & ordinance requirements; authorizes Florida Housing Finance Corporation to provide technical assistance to counties & municipalities; creates Adaptive Reuse Public-Private Partnership Council to facilitate & oversee development of adaptive reuse projects; requires council to monitor & perform project evaluations on regular basis; prohibits members of council from receiving compensation; authorizes reimbursement for travel expenses for certain members; requires council to report specified information to Governor & Legislature by specified date each year.

bill_title: Affordable Property Ad Valorem Tax Exemption on Leased Land
bill_desc: Authorizes certain leased land to qualify for specified ad valorem tax exemption; authorizes Department of Revenue to adopt emergency rules.

Prohibits organizations from granting water access at public bathing places & public swimming pools to certain children without first requiring specified information; requires organizations to provide specified types of personal flotation devices to certain children; authorizes public bathing places & public swimming pools to refuse water access to certain children requires certain counties & municipalities to create pilot programs to install drowning prevention stations at high-risk water access areas; provides; specifies information that each participating county & municipality must provide to DEP following conclusion of pilot program; requires DEP to submit final report to Governor & Legislature; provides contents of report; encourages local governments to implement sponsorship programs with businesses to help fund drowning prevention stations; requires DEP to coordinate public awareness campaign dealing with water safety during implementation of pilot program; requires parents or legal guardians of children with autism to provide specified information regarding water safety & swimming certifications to child's public school.

bill_title: Community-based Care Lead Agency and Subcontractor Liability
bill_desc: Lowers dollar amount limit of net economic damages in tort actions brought against lead agencies & subcontractors; provides that lead agencies & subcontractors that are direct providers of foster care & related services are not liable to pay any claim or judgment that exceeds specified amount; provides that attorney may not charge, demand, receive, or collect for services rendered fees that exceed specified amount of any judgment or settlement.
Revises provisions related to curators of estates including requirements for court reporting, authority & duties, bonding, removal, & reporting.

Provides conditions under which disconnection of residential utility services for nonpayment is prohibited & waiver of certain fees is required; authorizes utilities to voluntarily suspend disconnections to protect health & safety of customers & reliability of services; requires specified notice & alerts; provides penalties & remedies.
Revises definition of term "first responder" to include specified support personnel for provision of peer support.
Requires private schools participating in Family Empowerment Scholarship Program to provide specified information in writing to parents before student enrollment in school.

bill_title: Coverage for Out-of-network Ground Ambulance Emergency Services
bill_desc: Requires certain health insurers & HMOs to reimburse nonparticipating & out-of-network ambulance service providers at specified rate for providing ground ambulance services; provides that certain payments by insured constitute accord & satisfaction, & release, of certain claims; prohibits certain cost-sharing responsibilities paid from exceeding certain amount; provides that ambulance service provider & certain claims are subject to certain provisions; requires small employer carrier to comply with certain provisions.
Revises criteria & procedures for establishing rules for adult cardiovascular services.

bill_title: Motor Vehicle Manufacturers and Franchised Motor Vehicle Dealers
bill_desc: Prohibits applicant or licensee, or common entity thereof, from implementing sales or service performance measurement criteria without providing motor vehicle dealers with basis for any sales or service performance measurement; prohibits applicant or licensee, or common entity thereof, from engaging in certain retaliatory or discriminatory conduct; revises conditions under which discontinuation, cancellation, or nonrenewal of franchise agreement is considered unfair.
Revises date upon which certain background screenings of athletic coaches must be conducted.

Revises provisions relating to rule development, proposed rules, notices, public workshops, publication, timeframes, repromulgation requirements, statements of estimated regulatory costs, public hearings, lower cost regulatory alternatives, incorporation by reference, emergency rules, Florida Administrative Code, Florida Administrative Register, & annual regulatory plans.

Revises administrative powers & duties of PSC in overseeing telecommunications access system, procedures for distribution of specialized telecommunications devices, & composition of advisory committee; authorizes sheriff departments to purchase & operate telecommunications device for deaf.

bill_title: Tampering with an Electronic Monitoring Device
bill_desc: Revises offense of tampering with electronic monitoring device; provides specified penalty for person under 18 who commits offense; requires revocation of pretrial release of person who tampers with such device while on pretrial release; permits court new bond under specified conditions.

Removes requirements that school districts adopt grandfathered salary schedule & performance-based salary schedule; revises requirements for certain salary adjustments & supplements; & revises requirements for use of advanced degrees in setting salary schedules.

Requires IMPACT GNV of City of Gainesville, in collaboration with others, to develop & implement Gun Violence Prevention Pilot Program; provides eligibility & program requirements; provides alternatives to incarceration for specified youth; provides for referrals to specified programs; requires City of Gainesville, in collaboration with Alachua County, to annually submit specified report to IMPACT GNV of City of Gainesville by specified date; requires to IMPACT GNV of City of Gainesville to report specified information to Governor & Legislature by specified date.

Revises provisions relating to charter school codes of student conduct, enrollment, capacity, compliance with law, facilities, ad valorem taxes, student data; revises provisions relating to high-performing charter schools; revises provisions relating to sale, transfer, lease, or disposal of school district real property.
Exempts certain disabled veterans from required payment of tolls for use of toll facilities.
Requires that disability history & awareness instruction include specified materials.

Revises membership requirements for Board of Optometry; revises & provides rules to be implemented by board; revises requirements for administration & prescription of ocular pharmaceutical agents & provisions related to topical & oral ocular pharmaceutical agent formularies established by board; authorizes optometrist certified in ophthalmic procedures to perform certain procedures; requires board to determine required content, grading criteria, & passing score for such examination; authorizes certain procedures certified optometrist may perform; prohibits commercial or mercantile establishment from having any control over manner in which licensee practices optometry; removes provision prohibiting surgery of any kind; authorizes specified titles & abbreviations for certified optometrists; provides requirements for advertisements; provides requirements for demonstration of financial responsibility as term of licensure.

bill_title: Court Judgment Interest Rates and Insurance Reports and Practices
bill_desc: Revises calculation that CFO performs to set rate of interest payable on judgments or decrees; requires OIR to create specified reports on insurance-related entities & compensation of executive officers for insurers, licensees, & registrants; revises factors office must consider in determining whether insurance rate is excessive, inadequate, or unfairly discriminatory; requires property insurers to send policyholders written estimate of amount of loss; specifies certain requirements for insurers when creating & sending such estimates; prohibits insureds & insurers from waiving such requirements; revises manner in which property insurer must respond to notice to initiate litigation; requires claimant & property insurer to participate in mandatory mediation; requires court to determine attorney fees in specified manner for cases arising from property insurance dispute; requires property insurers to disclose to policyholders dollar amount of credit or premium discount for mandatory binding arbitration endorsement.
Revises definitions of terms "commercial pool/spa contractor," "residential pool/spa contractor," & "swimming pool/spa servicing contractor."
Requires FDLE to post on its website names of certain individuals who have violated specified animal cruelty provisions.

bill_title: Unlawful Distribution of Controlled Substances Resulting in Death
bill_desc: Revises elements of third degree murder.

bill_title: Resolution of Disputed Property Insurance Claims
bill_desc: Requires, rather than authorizes, parties in property insurance claim dispute to participate in mediation; provides that mediation is condition precedent to commencing litigation; provides that parties may mutually agree to conduct mediation by teleconference or other electronic means; requires all insureds, or their representatives, to personally attend mediation; revises & specifies duties relating to bearing certain costs of mediation; requires policyholder to provide insurer with any information & certain documents within specified timeframe after mediation is invoked; revises conditions under which policyholder has certain timeframe to rescind settlement.

Creates advisory council within OIR for specified purposes; provides for membership & meetings of advisory council; requires office to provide advisory council with staffing & administrative assistance; requires advisory council to submit specified report annually; provides for expiration of advisory council.
Revises definition of term "medical review committee."

bill_title: Admission To Practice Law by Unauthorized Alien
bill_desc: Provides that certain licenses to practice law will be revoked on specified date under certain circumstances.
Provides that certain students enrolled in adult education center are eligible for dual enrollment.

bill_title: Decreasing Racial and Ethnic Disparities in Mental Health and Substance Abuse Services
bill_desc: Revises project requirements & review criteria of Closing the Gap grant program to include mental health & substance abuse services.

Establishes procedure to allow adult who has mental capacity & who has terminal condition & who makes fully informed decision that he or she no longer wants to live, to obtain medication to end his or her life; provides requirements for health care providers, health care facilities & DOH.
Designates Congresswoman Frederica S. Wilson Boulevard in Miami-Dade County; directs DOT to erect suitable markers.
Provides penalty for failure by ambulatory surgical center to timely provide good faith estimate; requires AHCA to notify DLR upon adoption of certain federal rules.

Repeals multiple provisions of weather modification law; prohibits certain acts intended to affect temperature, weather, or intensity of sunlight within atmosphere of this state; increases civil penalties for violations of weather modification law.

bill_title: Leaving the Scene of a Crash Involving Only Damage to Vehicle or Property
bill_desc: Authorizes court to order driver convicted of leaving scene of crash to make restitution for specified damage.

Restricts local regulation of vessels outside marked boundaries of mooring fields in certain counties; designates specified sections of Biscayne Bay in Miami-Dade County as grandfathered-in anchoring limitation areas; increases prohibited anchoring & mooring distance of vessels & floating structures near public mooring fields.
Defines "first responder".
Provides that restrictive covenants which prohibit physician from practicing medicine within specified area for certain period of time are void & unenforceable.

bill_title: Investments of Public Funds in Bitcoin
bill_desc: Authorizes CFO to invest in Bitcoin any money from certain public funds; provides limits to such investments; provides requirements for holding such Bitcoin; authorizes CFO & other parties to loan Bitcoin in state funds; requires taxes & fees paid in Bitcoin to be transferred to General Revenue Fund; requires General Revenue Fund to reimburse designated funds in United States currency for such payments; authorizes Trustees of SBA to invest & reinvest available funds of System Trust Fund in Bitcoin; provides that investments of public funds in Bitcoin are exempt from certain security requirements.

Requires Florida Commission on Offender Review to develop & maintain database containing certain information for certain purpose; requires certain governmental entities to provide certain information to commission; requires DMS, acting through Florida Digital Service, to provide certain technical assistance to commission; requires commission to make database available to public on Internet website by certain date; requires commission to update database monthly & publish certain information on website; requires commission to provide comprehensive plan to Governor & Legislature by certain date; provides that person who takes certain actions in reasonable reliance on database may not be charged with certain violations of criminal law.

bill_title: Use of Artificial Intelligence by Governmental Agencies to Detect Concealed Firearms
bill_desc: Prohibits governmental agency or specified contractors from using or contracting with any other entities to use artificial intelligence to detect concealed firearms in public places; provides exceptions; provides remedy.

Removes State Consumer Health Information & Policy Advisory Council; requires memory care providers to follow specified standards of operation in providing memory care services; provides requirements for resident contracts; provides requirements for memory care facilities; prohibits certain facilities from advertising, representing, or holding themselves out as memory care providers unless they meet specified criteria; removes provisions relating to special care for persons with Alzheimer's disease or other disorders; removes rulemaking authority.

Prohibits agencies & independent contractors from taking specified actions against employees for disclosing certain information to Commission on Ethics; requires that information disclosed include specified violations or alleged violations; requires disclosure of specified information to commission; provides that specified provisions protect employees & persons who submit written complaints to commission or provide information to investigator during investigation of complaint; authorizes certain employees or applicants for employment to file complaints in accordance with specified provisions; authorizes such employees or applicants to pursue specified administrative remedy or civil action within specified timeframe; authorizes local public employees to file complaint with appropriate local governmental authority; provides requirements for administrative procedures created by local governmental authorities; authorizes such employee to bring civil actions in court of competent jurisdiction; requires specified relief; provides that it is affirmative defense to certain actions that adverse action was predicated on grounds other than exercising of certain protected rights.

bill_title: Nonprofit Agricultural Organization Medical Benefit Plans
bill_desc: Provides authority, duties, & prohibited acts of nonprofit agricultural organizations offering medical benefit plans to their members.

Authorizes certain manufacturers to sell malt beverages to vendors; authorizes manufacturer to terminate, cancel, nonrenew, or discontinue certain contracts under certain conditions; provides that such termination, cancellation, nonrenewal, or discontinuance is not violation of unlawful acts & practices provisions; authorizes Division of Alcoholic Beverages & Tobacco to determine manufacturer's yearly production amount, upon manufacturer's request; provides that certain information is prima facie evidence.

Prohibits person from operating motor vehicle while using wireless communications device in handheld manner; provides exception; requires that sustained use of wireless communications device by person operating motor vehicle be conducted through hands-free accessory until such use is terminated; revises exceptions to prohibition; removes obsolete provisions; revises penalty provisions relating to use of wireless communications devices in handheld manner in certain circumstances.

Revises provisions related to local business taxes including conditions imposed on taxing authorities governing levies, modification of ordinances, reclassification of businesses, prohibitions on revenues over a specified value, and audits.

bill_title: Location of Equipment Owned by Amusement Business Owner
bill_desc: Prohibits counties & municipalities from enacting certain policies, ordinances, regulations, or other measures that require payment from amusement business owner for placement, parking, or storage of equipment for longer than specified length of time on certain agricultural lands.

Provides exemption from public records requirements for personal identifying & location information of sexual assault counselors; provides for future legislative review & repeal of exemption; provides for retroactive application; provides statement of public necessity.

bill_title: Licensure by Endorsement to Practice Dentistry and Dental Hygiene
bill_desc: Prohibits specified persons from being licensed through Mobile Opportunity by Interstate Licensure Endorsement Act.

bill_title: Specific Medical Diagnoses in Child Protective Investigations
bill_desc: Requires that reports made by certain persons contain summary of specified analysis; provides exception to requirement that DCF immediately forward certain allegations to law enforcement agency; requires child protective investigator to inform subject of investigation of certain duty; requires Child Protection Teams to consult with licensed physician or APRN when evaluating certain reports; authorizes, under certain circumstance, parent or legal custodian from whom child was removed to request specified examinations of child; requires that certain examinations be paid for by parent or legal custodian making request or as otherwise covered by insurance or Medicaid.

Requires clerk of court, within 6 hours after court issues ex parte order for involuntary commitment, to submit order electronically to sheriff or law enforcement agency in county where order is to be served; requires clerk of court, within 6 hours after certain summons is issued, to submit summons electronically and, if applicable, copy of petition for involuntary services & notice of hearing to law enforcement agency to effect service on certain persons; requires clerk of court to transmit electronically, within certain timeframe after court issues risk protection order & notice of hearing, copy of order, notice of hearing, petition to appropriate law enforcement agency for service upon respondent; requires clerk of court to transmit electronically, within certain timeframe after court issues temporary ex parte risk protection order or risk protection order, copy of notice of hearing, petition, & temporary ex parte risk protection order or risk protection order, as applicable, to sheriff; requires that electronic copy of temporary ex parte risk protection order or risk protection order be certified by clerk of court & that electronic copy be served in same manner as certified copy.

Specifies when purchaser of controllable account or controllable payment intangible is qualifying purchaser; specifies rights acquired relating to controllable electronic records; prohibits actions from being asserted against qualifying purchasers; specifies that filing certain financial statement is not notice of claim of property right in controllable electronic record; authorizes account debtors on controllable account or controllable payment intangible to discharge obligations.

bill_title: Pub. Rec./ Municipal Clerks And Staff
bill_desc: Provides public records exemption for home addresses, telephone numbers, dates of birth, & photographs of municipal clerks & their staff, names, home addresses, telephone numbers, dates of birth, & places of employment of spouses & children of municipal clerks & their staff, & names & locations of schools & day care facilities attended by children of municipal clerks & their staff; provides for future legislative review & repeal of exemptions; provides statement of public necessity.

bill_title: Administration of Controlled Substances by Paramedics
bill_desc: Authorizes practitioner to cause certified paramedic to administer controlled substance.

bill_title: Commissioning Reporting Requirements for HVAC and Electrical Systems
bill_desc: Provides additional requirements for certain persons or authorities commissioning certain reports; defines "commissioning authority."
Directs DHSMV to develop Miami Northwestern Alumni Association, Inc. license plate; provides for distribution & use of fees collected from sale of plate.

bill_title: Foods Containing Vaccines or Vaccine Materials
bill_desc: Deems drug misbranded if it is food containing vaccine or vaccine material, but its label does not include specified information; deems food misbranded if it contains vaccine or vaccine material, but its label does not include specified information.

bill_title: Pub. Rec./Agency for Health Care Administration Personnel
bill_desc: Provides exemption from public records requirements for personal identifying & location information of certain current or former personnel of AHCA & names & personal identifying & location information of spouses & children of such personnel; provides for future legislative review & repeal.

Revises period of time before certain financial instruments may be canceled & certain monies may be forfeited; revises types of investments that SBA may make; authorizes SBA & affiliated limited liability entities to issue securities & borrow money through specified means.

bill_title: Child Care Facility and Program Background Screening Requirements
bill_desc: Defines "recreational enrichment program"; provides such programs are not required to obtain license from DCF; revises remedies that DCF may pursue for failure to comply with screening requirements; requires DCF, in conjunction with AHCA & FDLE, to develop & maintain statewide background screening public awareness campaign.

Creates Board of Naturopathic Medicine within DOH; provides for licensure by examination of naturopathic physicians; provides financial responsibility requirements as condition of licensure for naturopathic physicians; provides that patients are responsible for advising treating health care practitioners about any legend drug, nutrient, or natural medicinal substance that naturopathic physician has prescribed or recommended to patient; provides for licensure by endorsement of naturopathic physicians.

bill_title: Public Lodging and Public Food Service Establishments
bill_desc: Revises notification requirements for removing guests from public lodging & public food service establishments; authorizes public food service establishments to include automatic gratuity or service charge; requires such establishments to provide specified notice; prohibits automatic gratuity or service charges in certain circumstances; provides for computation of automatic or suggested gratuity or service charges.

bill_title: Offenses Committed Against Contractors Performing State Functions
bill_desc: Defines "contractor performing state functions"; provides for reclassification of certain offenses committed against contractor performing state functions.

Provides eligibility requirements; requires community-based care lead agency to calculate amount of financial assistance based on certain factors; requires community-based care lead agency to enter into formal agreements with eligible young adults; provides requirements for such agreement; requires community-based care lead agency to terminate agreement; requires specified notice be given to young adult before agreement is terminated; specifies circumstances under which community-based care lead agency can enter into subsequent agreement; provides duties of community-based care lead agency; prohibits community-based care lead agency from charging fee for certain services; requires DCF to advertise independent living housing grant & provide relevant information to certain person.

Provides that employer is not subject to state minimum wage requirements for specified employees; authorizes employees to voluntarily opt out of state minimum wage requirements by signing waiver; prohibits employer from taking certain actions; requires parent or guardian to sign waiver on employee's behalf if employee is minor; requires employers to pay employee at or above federal minimum wage; provides that employee's waiver to opt out of state minimum wage is only valid for specified timeframe.

Prohibits reservation at public food service establishment from being listed, advertised, promoted, or sold through third-party reservation platform; provides exception; authorizes Division of Hotels & Restaurants of DBPR to impose civil penalty not to exceed specified amount for violation of this act or of division rule; provides that such violations shall accrue on daily basis for certain establishments.

bill_title: Motor Vehicles Using the Furthermost Left-hand Lane
bill_desc: Defines "furthermost left-hand lane"; prohibits driver from operating motor vehicle in furthermost left-hand lane on specified roadways; provides exceptions; provides nonapplicability; requires DOT to make certain designations & install specified signage.
Revises definition; provides exception to prohibition of facility engaging in extraordinary collection action to obtain payment for services for sale of certain debt.

Requires state agencies to update geographic materials to reflect new federal designation of "Gulf of Mexico" as "Gulf of America"; & requires instructional materials & library media center collections adopted or acquired after specified date to reflect new federal designation of "Gulf of Mexico" as "Gulf of America".

Requires local enforcement agency to issue permit for fire alarm system project or fire sprinkler system project within specified timeframe; authorizes work to commence immediately; requires local enforcement agency to provide inspection within specified timeframe; requires that certain plans & specifications be available for onsite plans review during inspection; requires contractor to provide additional documents, if necessary, within specified timeframe; prohibits local enforcement agency from requiring additional plans reviews or documentation outside scope of permitted work; requires that permit fees be refunded by certain percentage if local government fails to meet certain deadlines; provides exceptions; requires local enforcement agencies to establish simplified permitting process by specified date; specifies condition under which local amendment to Florida Fire Prevention Code is null & void; provides that municipality may only enforce ordinance that has been sent to Florida Building Commission & State Fire Marshal as of date that bid for permit was submitted; requires uniform summary inspection report to include total number of deficiencies found during inspection of fire protection system or hydrant; removes requirement for brief summary of such deficiencies; removes exception from submitting certain information within detailed inspection report.

Provides that members of Florida State Guard are entitled to specified leaves of absences & specified discount on annual state park entrance passes; creates annual Florida State Guard gold sportsman's license; & establishes Florida State Guard Scholarship Program within DOE.

Revises qualifying medical conditions to include condition for which patient is prescribed specified opioid drugs; revises examination requirements for issuance or renewal of certification; revises amount of supply limits qualified physician may issue; revises frequency at which qualified physician must evaluate existing qualified patient before issuing new physician certification; revises reasons DOH may suspend registration of qualified physician; requires department to establish processes & procedures to issue medical marijuana use registry ID cards to, & to register as visiting qualified patient, nonresidents; provides waiver of certain fees for certain veterans; requires DOH to authorize each medical marijuana treatment center to operate as cultivator, processor, distributor, or retailer; requires department to initiate application process to issue specified number of certain licenses; provides requirements for applicant for licensure as marijuana licensee to operate as cultivator, processor, distributor, or retailer; provides requirements for modifications to marijuana licensee's operations, ownership, & change of ownership; provides requirements for inspections by department; authorizes department to impose certain fees; provides for preemption; prohibits unlicensed activity by marijuana licensees.
Authorizes members of Legislature to solemnize rights of matrimonial contract.

bill_title: Designation of the Official State Flagship
bill_desc: Redesignates official state flagship as S.S. American Victory.

Creates Statewide Office of Manufacturing within DOC; provides organizational structure & responsibilities for Chief Manufacturing Officer; directs all state & local governmental entities to assist Chief Manufacturing Officer; requires department to biennially prepare report regarding manufacturing efforts in this state; creates Florida Manufacturers' Workforce Development Grant Program; provides organization and purpose for grant program; provides criteria for receiving grant funds; creates "Florida Manufacturing Promotional Campaign"; authorizes department to establish Florida Manufacturing Promotional Campaign; provides purpose of campaign; provides regulations for participating in campaign.

Requires DOC to establish by rule registration & renewal fees sufficient to fund costs of administering Florida Manufacturing Promotional Campaign; requires DOC to assess & collect fees for purpose of promoting campaign; requires that such fees be deposited into Economic Development Trust Fund for specified purpose.
Defines "auxiliary container"; requires DEP to review & update specified report; prohibits local regulation of auxiliary containers; preempts such regulation to state.

Requires DOR to make monthly distributions from certain tax proceeds to State Transportation Trust Fund; requires counties to annually provide DOT with certain project data; requires DHSMV to create Next-generation Traffic Signal Modernization Program; requires DHSMV to issue expectant mother parking permits; revises conditions under which DOT may acquire property through eminent domain; revises membership of Center for Urban Transportation Research advisory board; provides requirements for certain project concept studies & project development & environmental studies; provides & revises requirements relating to competitive bidding, underground utility location, & M.P.O.'s; removes provisions relating to Metropolitan Planning Organization Advisory Council; requires DOT to prioritize certain Strategic Intermodal System highway corridor projects; authorizes DOT to expend certain funds for grants for purchase of certain equipment; provides legislative findings regarding widening of certain roadway; requires DOT to submit reports to Governor & Legislature; establishes airport pilot program at Sarasota Manatee Airport Authority.

Provides that charter school is public facility for purpose of concurrency; authorizes developers to provide specified improvements & contributions to public schools; requires developers to receive credits for impact fees from such improvements & contributions; provides requirements for location of such schools; requires such credits to be approved by local governments & special districts; prohibits local governing authorities from imposing or enforcing certain vehicular stacking ordinances or regulations against specified schools during certain hours; revises building requirements for charter schools; prohibits local governing authorities from requiring charter school to obtain certain exemptions or approvals under land development code for specified purposes relating to allowable uses.

Provides requirements relating to work-based learning opportunities, career fairs, career planning courses, & apprenticeship & preapprenticeship programs; requires student's personalized academic & career plan to be reviewed annually for certain period of time & signed by certain persons; requires such plan to be revised as necessary; requires adoption of regulations & rules to enable certain students to earn postsecondary credit & career education clock hours for certain training & education acquired while apprentice or preapprentice; requires Articulation Coordinating Committee to convene workshop by date certain to develop certain process; requires Articulation Coordinating Committee to review apprenticeship & preapprenticeship programs &, annually, approve prioritized list of postsecondary course equivalencies & minimum postsecondary credit or career education clock hours to be awarded for certain programs; requires certain information to be included in statewide articulation agreement; requires state universities, FCS institutions, & career centers to award postsecondary credit or career education clock hours; provides that postsecondary credit or career education clock hours are guaranteed to transfer to other state universities, FCS institutions, & career centers.

bill_title: Disqualification from Educator Certification and Employment
bill_desc: Prohibits person from being automatically found ineligible for educator certification & specified employment if certain offenses meet specified criteria.

bill_title: The Designation of the Gulf of Mexico
bill_desc: Changes designation of Gulf of Mexico to Gulf of America.

bill_title: County Price Controls for Removal and Storage of Electric Vehicles
bill_desc: Requires counties to establish specified rates for removal & storage of electric vehicles from accident scene; authorizes wrecker operator to charge specified costs for cleanup of accident scene & removal of such vehicles.

Requires counties & municipalities, respectively, to meet specified requirements regarding minimum information necessary for certain zoning applications; revises timeframes for processing applications for approvals of development permits or development orders; prohibits counties & municipalities, respectively, from limiting number of quasi-judicial or public hearings held each month; provides refund parameters in situations where county or municipality, respectively, fails to meet certain timeframes.

Revises requirements for calculation of additional full-time equivalent membership & certain bonuses based on International Baccalaureate examination scores of students to include students who earn equivalent scores as determined by DOE.

bill_title: Registration of Agents and Organizations Associated with Foreign Nations
bill_desc: Requires agents of foreign principal & foreign-supported political organizations to register with Division of Elections; requires division to create registration forms; provides requirements for such forms; requires periodic updates by agents & organizations; provides penalties for violations.

Provides conditions for cause of action against certain former phosphate mine sites; provides for certain notice of former phosphate mines; requires DOH to conduct surveys of former phosphate land parcels upon petition; requires that specified documentation of radiation levels be submitted in certain civil actions related to phosphate mining.

Revises definition of term "last known address"; revises notice requirements of owners of self-storage units in order to enforce lien on tenant's property; revises notice requirements for such owners who wish to sell such tenant's property; requires that rental agreements for renters of self-storage units which are entered into on or after specified date provide certain information in compliance with Florida Self-storage Facility Act; provides that failure or refusal of tenant to designate alternate contact does not affect tenant's or owner's rights or remedies; provides exception; authorizes owners of self-storage unit to send notice to certain tenants' last known address to apprise such tenants of specified right.

bill_title: Improvements to Structures on Agricultural Lands
bill_desc: Prohibits improvements to certain structures from increasing specified assessed values.

Revises scope of the Dr. & Mrs. Alfonse & Kathleen Cinotti Health Care Screening & Services Grant Program to allow grant funds to be used for screenings, referrals for treatment,& related services for autism; revises requirements for annual grant application submitted by DOH for Early Steps Program to conform to changes made by act; provides purpose for Early Steps Extended Option; authorizes department to implement Early Steps Extended Option regardless of certain federal funding; requires University of Florida Center for Autism & Neurodevelopment to fund specialized summer programs for children with autism spectrum disorder; creates University of Florida Center for Autism and Neurodevelopment.

Requires, rather than authorizes, certain dogs to be confiscated, impounded, & held; requires animal control authorities to provide certain information to protentional adopters; revises requirements for owners of dangerous dogs; revises civil penalty for violations.
Prohibits food establishments from manufacturing, selling, or distributing food that contains specified chemical additives.

Authorizes public school acquire & maintain supply of glucagon through specified means; authorizes specified health care practitioners to issue prescription for glucagon in public school's name; provides for adoption of specified protocols relating to administration of undesignated glucagon; provides requirements for administration of undesignated glucagon; requires parental notification after administration of glucagon; requires SBE in cooperation with DOH to adopt specified rules; provides certain persons & entities with immunity from civil & criminal liability.

Provides that property owner is liable for damages caused by trees or shrubs located on his or her property when they fall on another's property; provides applicability; provides that trees & shrubs located on two or more parcels may be removed by any of property owners after serving proper notice & posting on other parcels; provides exception.

Revises & provides conditions for manufacture, delivery, hold, offer for sale, distribution, & retail sale of hemp extract products; requires manufacturers, distributors, & retailers of hemp extract products to maintain certain records; prohibits DACS from granting permission to remove or use certain hemp extract products until it determines that such hemp extract products comply with state law; provides appropriations.

bill_title: Canine Support Grant Program for First Responders
bill_desc: Requires FDLE & State Fire Marshal to establish & jointly administer grant program; provides requirements for grants, support dogs, & handlers; provides for oversight & annual reporting.

Directs DHSMV to develop Supporting FHP Troopers license plate; provides for distribution & use of fees collected from sale of plate; exempts plate from minimum presale voucher requirements & minimum valid registration requirements.
Authorizes grandparent of minor child to petition court for court-ordered visitation with child in certain circumstances.

Requires SBE & BOG to ensure FCS institutions & state universities, respectively, are free from political influence & interference in specified activities; removes prohibition against such boards shielding students, faculty, & staff from specified speech; provides that students & faculty in State University System & Florida College System have specified rights relating to academic freedom.

bill_title: Artificial Food Dyes in K-12 Schools
bill_desc: Prohibits use of specified dyes in foods for certain K-12 food programs; & requires district school boards to adopt policy prohibiting use of specified food dyes in foods for certain food programs & vending machines; & provides exemptions from such prohibition.

Prohibits jail or other adult facility from holding child w transferred to adult court for criminal prosecution before hearing to determine if child should be prosecuted as an adult, unless hearing waived; removes requirement for state attorney to request court to transfer & certify child for prosecution as adult or to provide written reasons to court for not making such request; removes references to state attorney's discretion to direct file juvenile; revises discretionary direct file criteria; provides for due process evidentiary hearing before judge upon filing by state attorney of information transferring child to adult court; provides requirements for order to transfer to adult court.

bill_title: Electronic Delivery of Notices Between Landlords and Tenants
bill_desc: Authorizes landlord or tenant to electronically deliver notices to other party if certain conditions are met; requires addendum to rental agreement to be in specified form; authorizes party to revoke his or her agreement to electronic delivery without invalidating notices previously sent by e-mail; specifies when such revocation takes effect; authorizes party to update his or her e-mail address; specifies when such update takes effect; provides that notice delivered by e-mail is deemed delivered at time e-mail is sent; provides exception; requires sender of e-mail to maintain certain information.

bill_title: Local Government Approval of Affordable Housing Property Tax Exemptions
bill_desc: Expands property tax exemption on certain multifamily projects; provides requirements to receive such exemption; authorizes local governments to approve certain properties for such exemption; provides requirements for local governing body.

bill_title: Termination of Rental Agreement by Victim of Domestic Violence, Dating Violence, Sexual Violence, or Stalking
bill_desc: Prohibits landlord from evicting tenant or terminating rental agreement because tenant or tenant's minor child is victim of actual or threatened domestic violence, dating violence, sexual violence, or stalking; specifies that rental agreement may not contain certain provisions; authorizes victim of such actual or threatened violence or stalking to terminate rental agreement; requires certain documentation & written notice to landlord; provides for liability for rent for both tenant & perpetrator, if applicable; specifies that tenant does not forfeit certain money paid to landlord for terminating rental agreement; requires landlord to change locks of dwelling unit within specified time period; authorizes tenant to change locks of dwelling unit; prohibits certain actions by landlord; authorizes filing of civil action & award of damages, fees, & costs; prohibits waiver of certain provisions.

Prohibits drilling or exploration for, or production of, oil, gas, or other petroleum products & permitting & construction of certain related structures; requires statewide renewable energy electricity & carbon emission reductions by specified dates; directs Office of Energy within DACS to develop unified statewide plan & submit plan to Governor & Legislature; creates Renewable Energy Advisory Committee; directs Commissioner of Agriculture to submit annual report to Legislature.

bill_title: Pub. Rec./County and City Administrators and Managers
bill_desc: Provides exemption from public records requirements for personal identifying & location information of current county administrators, deputy county administrators, assistant county administrators, city managers, deputy city managers, & assistant city managers, including names & personal identifying & location information of spouses & children of current county administrators, deputy county administrators, assistant county administrators, city managers, deputy city managers, & assistant city managers; provides for future legislative review & repeal; provides for retroactive application; provides statement of public necessity.
Requires medical spa facilities to prominently post on its website & in conspicuous location in its facility specified information about physician supervising the facility.

bill_title: Preventing the Spread of Avian Influenza
bill_desc: Creates Be Ready Task Force within DOH for specified purpose; provides for membership & meetings of task force; requires task force to develop specified recommendations; providing that task force members are entitled to receive reimbursement for per diem & travel expenses; requires task force to submit report of its recommendations to Governor & Legislature by specified date; provides for dissolution of task force.

bill_title: Criminal Conflict and Civil Regional Counsel Membership in the Senior Management Service Class
bill_desc: Provides participation in Senior Management Service Class of FRS is compulsory for assistant regional counsel supervisors, beginning on a specified date.
Requires state universities to waive specified fees for graduate students who meet specified full-time equivalent appointment requirement.

Requires DCF to contract biennially for specified functions; requires DCF to contract for recommendations for certain transparency improvements; requires DCF to prepare & present to Governor & Legislature specified final report by specified date; requires managing entities to report required data to DCF in standardized electronic format; provides requirements for such format; requires managing entities to electronically submit to DCF certain documents in specified format & with specified metadata; requires managing entities to submit certain specific measures to DCF; requires DCF to post & maintain such measures on its website by specified date every month; requires managing entities to report each measure using standard methodology determined by DCF; provides requirements for such measures.

Authorizes candidate to pay filing fee by specified debit card; revises timeframe in which candidate shall pay filing fee if candidate's check is returned by bank; authorizes certain candidates to challenge whether another candidate has complied with specified requirements; provides requirements for such challenge; requires certain signatures only if there is place for such signatures on receipt of payment by debit card.

bill_title: Term Limits for State Representatives and Senators
bill_desc: Proposes amendment of State Constitution to revise term limits applicable to state representatives & state senators.
Revises base salary used to calculate compensation of clerk of circuit court & county comptroller, supervisor of elections, & property appraiser, respectively.
Requires food & drink products intended for human consumption that contain synthetic dyes to have certain warning on products' packaging; requires DACS to conduct certain inspections.

Revises circumstances under which insurance coverage is eligible for export; removes diligent effort & other requirements before insurance coverage is eligible for export; transfers to surplus lines insurance those provisions relating to liability of insureds & deductibles, insurers' duty to acknowledge communications regarding residential property insurance claims & investigations, notice of property insurance claim, suits arising under property insurance policy, surplus lines agent licenses & appointments, assignment agreements, nonjoinder of insurers, & representations in applications & warranties.
Authorizes general permit for replacement of certain septic systems & installation of certain wastewater treatment units; provides requirements for such permits & permittees.

Revises who may file certificate of death or fetal death; revises definition of "primary or attending practitioner"; revises who may note corrected information on permanent certificate of death or fetal death.

bill_title: Autonomous Practice by a Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist
bill_desc: Revises staff membership & clinical privileges for certified registered nurse anesthetists; authorizes certified registered nurse anesthetists to perform specified acts; revises practice requirements for an autonomous advanced practice registered nurse & for certified nurse midwives; authorizes autonomous advanced practice registered nurse to perform certain acts.

bill_title: Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services
bill_desc: Revises & creates provisions related to DACS powers, duties, functions, & programs.
Adds as an aggravating factor that capital felony was committed against head of state, or in an attempt to commit such crime capital felony was committed against another individual.

Requires pet insurers to make certain disclosures to pet insurance applicants & policyholders, including summary of their bases or formulas for determination of claim payments under pet insurance policy; requires pet insurers to disclose certain requirements for required medical examinations of pet; authorizes pet insurance applicants & policyholders to examine & return insurance policies & riders within certain timeframe; authorizes pet insurers to issue policies that exclude coverage on basis of preexisting conditions; provides that pet insurer has specified burden of proof with regard to such exclusions; authorizes pet insurers to issue new policies that impose waiting period for specified illnesses, diseases, or conditions; prohibits pet insurers from issuing policies imposing waiting period for accidents; authorizes pet insurers to require examination after purchase of policy; prohibits pet insurer from requiring medical examination to renew policy; prohibits insurance applicants' eligibility from being based on participation or lack of participation in wellness programs.

Requires drug manufacturers to sell specified drugs to Medicaid pharmacies at 340B Drug Pricing Program discounted prices; requires drug manufacturers to pay rebates to state; requires pharmacy benefits managers participating in Medicaid program to pay Medicaid pharmacies for specified drugs at 340B Drug Pricing Program discounted prices; requires drug wholesalers & distributors to sell specified drugs to Medicaid pharmacies at 340B Drug Pricing Program discounted prices; prohibits drug wholesalers & distributors from changing current pricing models & programs by engaging in certain acts; limits sales by Medicaid pharmacies of specified drugs at 340 Drug Pricing Program discounted prices to specified Medicaid recipients.

Establishes Florida Museum of Black History Board of Directors; provides for membership of board; requires that appointments to board be made by specified date; prohibits specified members of board from holding state or local elective office while serving on board; provides for filling of vacancies; requires that board work jointly with Foundation for Museum of Black History, Inc.; requires St. Johns County Board of County Commissioners to provide administrative support & staffing to board until specified actions are completed.

bill_title: One-Water Approach Toward the State's Water Supply
bill_desc: Expresses support for one-water approach toward this state's water supply, managing all water, whether from tap, stream, storm, aquifer, or sewer, in collaborative, integrated, inclusive, & holistic manner to support future growth of this state's water supply & avoid any projected shortages.

bill_title: Use of Tracking Devices or Applications to Commit Dangerous Crimes
bill_desc: Provides enhanced criminal penalties for installation, placement, or use of tracking devices or tracking applications to commit or facilitate commission of dangerous crimes.

bill_title: Local Government Impact Fees and Development Permits and Orders
bill_desc: Prohibits county from requiring applicant to take certain actions as condition of processing development permit or development order; defines "extraordinary circumstances"; requires that demonstrated-need study include certain information; prohibits municipality from requiring applicant to take certain actions as condition of processing development permit or development order.

Requires that certain articles or broadcasts be removed from specified websites within specified period to limit damages for defamation; provides persons in certain positions relating to newspapers with immunity for defamation if such persons exercise due care to prevent publication of defamatory statement.
Prohibits local governments from requiring minimum bond ratings in certain circumstances.

bill_title: Electronic Payment of Public Records Fees
bill_desc: Requires certain agencies to provide electronic option for payment of fees associated with public records requests.
Provides freshwater fishing vessel licensure fees.

bill_title: Grants for Low-income Senior Citizen Condominium Unit Owners
bill_desc: Requires Florida Housing Finance Corporation to establish by rule requirements for specified grant; provides maximum amount for such grant.

bill_title: State Group Insurance Program Coverage of Standard Fertility Preservation Services
bill_desc: Requires DMS under state group insurance program to provide coverage of medically necessary expenses relating to standard fertility preservation services for specified policies; prohibits state-contracted HMOs & state group health insurance plans from requiring preauthorization for such services; authorizes maximum benefit provisions,

bill_title: Term Limits for Members of County Commissions and District School Boards
bill_desc: Proposes amendment to the Constitution to provide term limits for members of boards of county commissioners and district school boards.

Revises requirements for uniform minimum standards & policies governing apprenticeship & preapprenticeship programs & agreements to include requirements for partnerships between local educational agencies & apprenticeship & preapprenticeship programs; revises required date for specified report on apprenticeship & preapprenticeship programs; requires DOE to develop standard model contract template for local educational agencies & apprenticeship & preapprenticeship programs; provides requirements for local educational agencies & apprenticeship & preapprenticeship programs that enter into partnership agreements; requires DOE to develop apprenticeship funding transparency tool; provides requirements for District Workforce Education Funding Steering Committee meetings; provides requirements for certain workpapers; authorizes such meetings to be held using communications media technology.

Prohibits local governments from adopting or enforcing any ordinances or policy to prohibit property owners from installing synthetic turf on their land, or single-family residential areas; provides procedures to be used by local governmental entity when receiving price quote from contractor pursuant to change order; provides penalties for failure to follow procedures; provides applicability; prohibits state or political subdivision from taking specified actions against certain bidders for construction work; prohibits local governments from requiring copies of specified documents for issuance of building permit.

bill_title: Conversion of Hotels into Residential Housing
bill_desc: Creates Hotel-to-home Tax Credit Program for certain purpose; authorizes tax credit for certain projects; authorizes FHFC to allocate credits; providing program requirements & procedures.

Provides enhanced penalties for DUI & BUI manslaughter & vehicular & vessel homicide if person has prior conviction for specified offenses; ranks offenses on offense severity ranking chart of Criminal Punishment Code.

bill_title: Collaborative Pharmacy Practice for Chronic Health Conditions
bill_desc: Excludes specified conditions from the definition of "chronic health condition."

Authorizes certain domestic wastewater treatment facilities to request incorporation of reclaimed water projects identified in Outstanding Florida Springs recovery or prevention strategies; requires DEP to approve such requests if certain conditions are met.
Provides additional aggravating factor for sentencing for capital felonies if victim was gathered with one or more persons for specified activities.

Revises membership of Florida Building Code Administrators & Inspectors Board & Florida Building Commission; revises provisions relating to building code inspection services provided by private provider & private provider firms, including agreement requirements, permit fees, administrative fees, responsibilities of private providers, permitting & inspection documents & reports, timeframes for issuing permits, authority of local building official, notices of incomplete forms, duly authorized representatives, authority of private providers acting as local building official, emergency inspection services, creation of certain forms, systems of registration, audits, immunity, civil causes of action, posting of permits on specified websites, & adoption of a uniformed permitting system.
Provides honorary designations of certain transportation facilities in specified counties; directs DOT to erect suitable markers.

bill_title: Noncriminal Traffic Infractions Causing Vehicle Crashes
bill_desc: Provides specified penalties for certain infractions resulting in crash with another vehicle & requires hearing for such infractions.

Authorizes county or eligible municipality to expend certain funds on lot rental assistance to mobile home owners for specified time period; requires counties & eligible municipalities to develop certain strategies in their local housing assistance plans; provides that lot rental assistance is approved home ownership activity for certain purposes; authorizes certain funds to be provided to mobile home owners for rehabilitation & emergency repairs; removes prohibition that only certain percentage of funds may be used for manufactured housing.

Requires utility owners to provide DOT & local governmental entities with utility relocation schedules within certain timeframe to expedite work; revises timeframe within which utility owner must initiate work; requires service provider to perform work under specific circumstances; requires authority to pay relocation expenses in certain instances.

bill_title: Annual Rate Increases for Coverages by Citizens Property Insurance Corporation
bill_desc: Provides that required annual rate increases & limits on such increases for coverages by Citizens Property Insurance Corporation do not apply to new policies issued after specified date & to subsequent renewals of such policies,

Revises requirements for individual to be exempt from completing continuing education; requires Florida Building Code Administrators & Inspectors Board to establish rules relating to special inspectors & their representatives, voluntary inspector categories, plans examiners, inspector certifications, & internship programs; provides internship requirements; authorizes information be given virtually for certain exemption; provides requirements for change of contractor; provides limited liability; requires applicant to file notice of commencement if direct contract is more than specified amount; removes need for certified copy of recorded notice of commencement; revises building permit application form.

Authorizes holders of valid pari-mutuel permit to lease certain facilities to any other holder of same pari-mutuel permit or to any jai alai permitholder when located within specified radius of each other; authorizes such lessees to apply for certain license; prohibits such lessees from operating cardroom or slot machine at leased facility; requires certain jai alai permitholders to conduct minimum number of live performances using their existing permit.

Requires FDLE, in cooperation with specified agencies, to establish & implement Spectrum Alert; develop training program & alert system for missing children with autism spectrum disorder which is compatible with existing alert systems; specifies requirements for training program.

Requires AHCA to provide certain treatments for chronic disease of obesity; provides for coverage of & access to such treatments; authorizes rulemaking; provides construction; requires AHCA to provide coverage through Medicaid reimbursement for diabetes prevention program; authorizes DOH to apply for state plan amendment.

Revises definition of term "roofing contractor"; revises official start date that residential property owner may cancel contract to replace or repair roof without penalty or obligation; revises language required to be in contract, or attached thereto, to replace or repair roof that is executed within a specified time of declaration of state of emergency in certain circumstances.

bill_title: Unlawful Demolition of Historical Buildings and Structures
bill_desc: Authorizes code enforcement board or special magistrate to impose fine that exceeds certain limits for unlawful demolition of certain historical buildings or structures; provides that such fine may not exceed certain percentage of just market valuation.

bill_title: Federal Approval for Community Health Workers as Medicaid Providers
bill_desc: Requires AHCA to seek federal approval by specified date to enroll & recognize community health workers as Medicaid providers & to use certain funds & means to secure financing for workers' services; provides guidelines for federal approval; provides reporting requirements.

Requires AHCA to approve drug products for Medicaid recipients for treatment of serious mental illness without step-therapy prior authorization; directs agency to include rate impacts resulting from act in certain rates that become effective on specified date.

Requires DOH, in collaboration with school districts throughout state, to develop informational materials for early detection of Type 1 diabetes for parents & guardians of certain students; provides requirements for such informational materials; requires early learning coalitions to notify parents & guardians of availability of such informational materials.

bill_title: Health Insurance Coverage for CAR T-Cell Therapies
bill_desc: Prohibits specified individual health insurance policies, group health insurance policies, & health maintenance contracts from refusing to contract with in-network health care facilities for provision of CAR T-cell therapies; prohibits such policies & contracts from denying coverage for therapies.

bill_title: Use of State Resources to Influence Statewide Ballot Initiatives
bill_desc: Provides short title, legislative intent, & definitions; prohibits certain entities from producing, disseminating, or funding specified public service announcements during certain timeframe; provides construction; requires certain entities to maintain specified records & make such records available to public.

Authorizes certain individuals to use title "veterinary professional associate"; authorizes veterinary professional associates to perform certain duties only while under responsible supervision of licensed veterinarian; specifies certain education requirements; prohibits such associates from prescribing certain drugs or controlled substances or performing certain surgical procedures; provides that supervising veterinarians are liable for the acts or omissions of veterinary professional associates under their supervision.

bill_title: Standardized Tests for Admission to Medical Institutions of Higher Education
bill_desc: Requires medical institutions of higher education to have standardized admissions test focused on specified knowledge & skills.

Revises & removes provisions relating to institutional controls for mapping purposes; monetary compensation; site rehabilitation agreements; tax credits; brownfield area designations; & participation in brownfield program; prohibits DEP & local pollution control programs from denying specified status or refusing to issue specified order for certain brownfield sites.

Provides sovereignty submerged land leases for Clean Marine Manufacturer facilities; provides competitive grant programs for construction & maintenance of public parking lots for boat-hauling vehicles & trailers.
Revises required instruction in specified life skills to include career readiness, financial literacy, & home economics.

bill_title: Sanitary and Storm Water System Standards
bill_desc: Requires that all sanitary & storm water systems comply with specified state DOT standards for certain elements; provides inspection requirements for such systems; specifies that certain local standards are superseded; provides finding of an important state interest.
Revises criteria for termination of pregnancy during viability.
Requires social media platforms to allow parents or guardians & law enforcement officers to view messages & prohibit minor account holders from using or accessing certain messages.

bill_title: Tax Exemption on Sales of Indigenous Arts and Crafts
bill_desc: Creates exemption from sales tax for sales of indigenous products; requiring the Department of Commerce to maintain a specified registry.

bill_title: Doula Services in Maternal Health Initiatives
bill_desc: Creates Doula Support for Healthy Births Pilot Program within DOH for specified purposes; requires DOH, in collaboration with its maternal & child health section, to implement & oversee pilot program; specifies duration of pilot program, subject to funding; requires pilot program to target specified populations for enrollment; specifies services that will be provided under pilot program; requires department to collaborate with specified entities to integrate doula services into existing maternal health programs & facilitate outreach & service delivery; authorizes department to integrate doula services into existing maternal & child health programs as expansion of pilot program, subject to certain requirements; provides for funding of pilot program.

bill_title: Benefits for Firefighters Injured During Training Exercises
bill_desc: Provides that firefighter & his or her spouse & dependent children are eligible for certain insurance coverage if firefighter is totally & permanently disabled during official training exercise.

bill_title: Law Enforcement, Correctional, and Correctional Probation Officer Benefits
bill_desc: Provides that law enforcement, correctional, or correctional probation officer & his or her spouse & dependent children are eligible for certain insurance coverage if officer is injured in line of duty or engaged in official training exercise.

Increases amount of lottery retailer bond; authorizes lottery retailer to remit funds to Department of Lottery for deposit in specified bank account in lieu of such bond; authorizes department to act as courier service & contract with third party to provide such service; requires all courier services to have written agreement that conforms to certain requirements & rules; authorizes courier services to store lottery tickets for customers in lieu of delivery; requires such courier services to maintain secure database of all stored lottery tickets & provide specified notice of winning ticket; authorizes such courier services to redeem winning tickets; prohibits portion or percentage of such winning tickets from being charged, accepted, given, or paid to such courier services; prohibits courier service from operating without written agreement; prohibits certain false claims & theft of lottery tickets by lottery retailers, courier services, or employees.

Requires applicant for licensure to submit specified notarized statement to DBPR; subjecting licensed contractor to disciplinary action; requires contractor to return contractee's deposit; authorizes contractor to retain portion of deposit; subjecting contractor to disciplinary action, including suspension of his or her license,; provides criminal penalties for certain violations; requires department to create & adopt by date certain standardized disciplinary form for certain purpose; provides requirements for local construction regulation boards; requires department to record each submitted form in specified automated system; requires specified report by date certain; requires financial literacy standards to include specified content for consumer protection awareness relating to construction contracting beginning in specified school year..

Provides criteria that may be used to evidence actual or simulated lewd exhibition of genitals; prohibits willfully generating an altered sexual depiction of an identifiable person, without consent of identifiable person; revises applicability.

bill_title: Minimum Age for Firearm Purchase or Transfer
bill_desc: Reduces minimum age at which person may purchase firearm & age of purchasers to which specified licensees are prohibited from selling or transferring firearm.
Limits specified tax deferral to properties with just value of $1 million or less; increases minimum value of tax certificate that may be sold at public auction or by electronic sale.
Requires OIR to provide consumer guide relating to homeowner's insurance on publicly accessible website; specifies requirements for such guide.
Designates October 21 of each year as "Celia Cruz Day."

Revises membership of Board of Veterinary Medicine; establishes application criteria for persons who desire to become & who are licensed as veterinary technicians; authorizes licensed veterinary technicians or technologists to perform specified services under supervision of licensed veterinarians; provides that licensed veterinarians are responsible for all services performed by licensed veterinary technicians or technologists; provides services that only licensed veterinarians may make or provide; authorizes supervising veterinarian to delegate to licensed veterinary technician responsibility of supervising certain tasks performed by unlicensed persons.
Provides exemption from public records requirements for records relating to licensed veterinary technicians until specified criteria are met; provides statement of public necessity.

Removes special assessments as source of funding for certain municipal facilities & services; removes ability of legislative & governing body of county to levy & collect special assessments; removes special assessments as mechanism to finance services or programs rendered specially for benefit of property or residents in unincorporated areas; requires certain ordinances or land development regulations to provide for reimbursement by local government; makes local government responsible for payment of fees or taxes assessed for conservation easements for certain land development projects.

bill_title: Revising How Homestead Property is Assessed
bill_desc: Proposes an amendment to the State Constitution to revise how homestead property is assessed.
