Requires health care practitioner to notify patient in writing upon referring patient to certain providers; provides requirements for such notice; requires certain health insurers to apply payments for services provided by nonpreferred providers toward insureds' deductibles & out-of-pocket maximums if specified conditions are met.

bill_title: Services for Individuals with Developmental Disabilities
bill_desc: Requires APD to post its quarterly reconciliation reports on its website within specified timeframe; requires agency to participate in transition planning activities & to post total number of individuals in each priority category on its website; establishes Statewide Family Care Council; requires local family care councils to report policy changes & program recommendations to statewide council in annual report; provides for appointments of local council members; provides for creation of family-led nominating committees; revises implementation & eligibility requirements of pilot program for individuals with developmental disabilities; requires APD to transmit to AHCA weekly data files of specified clients; requires AHCA to provide call center for specified purposes & to coordinate with DCF & APD to disseminate information about pilot program; requires participating plans to conduct individualized assessment of each enrollee within specified timeframe for certain purposes & to offer certain services to such enrollees; requires AHCA to conduct monitoring & evaluations & require corrective actions or payment of penalties; removes coordination requirements for agency when submitting certain reports, establishing specified measures, & conducting quality assurance monitoring of pilot program; revises specified dates for submitting certain status reports.
Revises provisions relating to certain internships & courses, Florida Bright Futures Scholarship Program awards, career dual enrollment agreements, & dual enrollment articulation agreements.
Revises eligibility requirements for student who earns high school diploma from non-Florida school.

bill_title: Health Care Provider Participation in Medicaid Managed Care Organizations
bill_desc: Requires that health care providers wanting to participate in Medicaid managed care organizations enroll with AHCA & be credentialed for & enter into contract with Medicaid managed care organizations; requires agency to enroll health care providers within specified timeframe; provides date of enrollment; requires health care providers to submit credentialing applications to credentialing verification organizations; provides requirements for contracts between agency & such organizations; provides requirements for contracts between Medicaid managed care organizations & health care providers; encouraging licensing boards to cooperate with agency & credentialing verification organizations; provides date on which providers' claims become eligible for payment; prohibits Medicaid managed care organizations from imposing certain requirements relating to clean claims within specified timeframe.
Provides that only students with disabilities may earn certificate of completion; revises learning opportunities available to certain students.

Revises uniform core curricula for state-approved teacher preparation programs, requirements for postsecondary educator preparation institutes, & competency-based professional learning certification programs to include specified mathematics content.

Requires that certain surtax revenues which are shared with school districts must also be shared with charter schools on proportionate basis in accordance with certain provisions; revises provisions relating to charter schools & schools of hope.

bill_title: Notification Of Anti-harassment Policies and Supportive Measures
bill_desc: Requires schools to establish anti-harassment policies & supportive measures; provides requirements for policies & measures.

Requires hospital emergency departments to develop & implement policies & procedures, conduct training, record weights in certain manner, designate pediatric emergency care coordinator, & conduct specified assessments; authorizes hospital with emergency department to conduct National Pediatric Readiness Project's Open Assessment under certain conditions; requires agency to adopt certain rules for comprehensive emergency management plans, and, in consultation with Florida Emergency Medical Services for Children State Partnership Program, establish minimum standards for pediatric patient care in hospital emergency departments; requires agency to collect & publish results of specified assessments submitted by hospitals by specified dates; provides requirements for collection & publication of such assessment scores.

bill_title: Unmanned Aircraft and Unmanned Aircraft Systems
bill_desc: Revises definition of "critical infrastructure facility"; provides exception to prohibition on operating drone over critical infrastructure facility; increases criminal penalty for certain prohibited actions relating to drones; prohibits certain actions relating to unmanned aircraft or unmanned aircraft systems; provides exceptions; provides criminal penalties; revises & provides exceptions to certain prohibited actions relating to drones; & provides criminal penalties & applicability.
Authorizes municipalities to use certain funds for specified purpose.

Revises provisions relating to creation of Department of Commerce & its powers & duties; establishes Office of Secure Florida within DOC; revises economic policies of state comprehensive plan to promote entrepreneurship from certain business startups; revises composition of statewide advisory board of Florida Small Business Development Center Network; creates Rural Accelerator Program within DOC; requires funds to be appropriated from Rural Infrastructure Fund; revises composition requirements of Florida Sports Foundation; revises provisions relating to convention grants program established by Florida Tourism Industry Marketing Corporation; revises provisions relating to use of statewide contracts register & who Small Business Development Center is required to coordinate with regarding such use; authorizes counties & municipalities to enter into agreements to create regional planning entities pursuant to specified law; replaces regional planning councils with DEP for purposes of hazardous waste management assessments & facilities; revises provisions relating to local health councils; revises composition of Affordable Housing Study Commission.

Requires DCF to provide specified assessment data to Legislature as part of certain annual report; requires DCF to maintain certain data in specified format; requires DCF to develop child protective investigator & case manager recruitment program; specifies requirements for program; specifies duties of DCF under program, to be completed in collaboration with lead agencies; subject to appropriation, requiring DCF to develop 4-year pilot program for treatment foster care; limits participation in pilot program to certain children; requires DCF to identify two judicial circuits for implementation of pilot program; requires DCF to arrange for independent evaluation of pilot program; requires DCF to establish certain minimum standards for pilot program; requires DCF to submit specified final report to Governor & Legislature; requires DCF to convene case management workforce workgroup; provides for membership & duties of work group; provides for meetings of workgroup; provides for operation of workgroup until specified date; requires workgroup to submit report to Governor & Legislature; provides requirements for such report; requires DCF to contract for detailed study of bed capacity for residential treatment services for child victims of commercial sexual exploitation; requires that study be completed by specified date; provides requirements for study.

Expands public record exemption for crime victims to include name & personal identification number of victim & any other information or records that could be used to locate, intimidate, harass, or abuse victim or victim's family; including records generated by any agency that regularly generates information from or concerning victims of crime in such exemption; provides exception to public record exemption; provides that certain records identifying law enforcement officers who are involved in use of force incident are confidential & exempt for specified period of time; provides requirements for extension of time of such period; authorizes waiver of exemptions; provides for future legislative review & repeal of exemptions.

bill_title: Affordable Housing and Supportive Services for Persons with Developmental Disabilities
bill_desc: Provides incentives for development of affordable housing & employment of persons with disabilities, including exemption from ad valorem taxation for certain property, exemption from sales tax for certain building materials, waiver of certain impact fees, tax credits for certain businesses, & certain tax refunds; provides criminal penalties; provides requirements to Florida Housing Finance Corporation; requires DCF to establish Tenant-Based Rental Assistance Program to provide rent subsidies to certain persons up to specified percentage of fair market rent; requires APD to administer funding for certain services; requires APD to establish Regional Housing & Employment Support Centers to provide specified services; requires DOE to expand vocational training programs for certain persons; requires DOT to establish program to provide transportation vouchers to certain persons; requires DOT to prioritize certain state funding; requires Department of Commerce to conduct annual compliance audit for specified purpose; provides penalties for noncompliance; requires specified annual report to Governor & Legislature; provides sources of funding; provides appropriation.

Provides for regional representation on FWCC; revises membership & terms; authorizes commission to define geographic boundaries of regions; prohibits certain persons from entering upon private land without warrant.

Authorizes certain out-of-state licensed practitioners to conduct medical evaluations; requires certain students to receive electrocardiogram to participate in interscholastic athletic competition; provides exemption from such procedure; & provides immunity from liability.

Prohibits boards, agencies, commissions, & any authority of any county, municipal corporation, or political subdivision from restricting or prohibiting fuel sources & appliances used to provide energy to consumers; revises retroactive applicability to include boards, agencies, commissions, and any authority of any county, municipal corporation, & political subdivision.

Prohibits physicians from knowingly performing or inducing termination of pregnancy after determining that fetus is sustainable outside womb through standard medical measures, with exceptions; revises exceptions.

Requires documentation supporting that financial considerations & payments to affiliates by reciprocal insurers are fair & reasonable; authorizes reciprocal insurers to require subscriber contributions; provides applicability of specialty insurer provisions & nonapplicability of continuing care provider requirements to bondholders; specifies circumstances under which continuing care providers may withdraw specified percentage of required minimum liquid reserve; provides that continuing care & continuing care at-home contracts are not subordinate to any secured claims & must be treated with higher priority over all other claims in event of receivership or liquidation proceedings against continuing care provider; requires each continuing care facility to have its own designated resident representative; provides requirements for providers who borrow or solicit funds from residents; prohibits persons from acting or holding themselves as management companies for continuing care retirement communities without certificate of authority; provides guidelines for commissioner to determine if provider or facility is insolvent or in imminent danger of becoming insolvent; requires office to record notices of lien against continuing care facilities' properties.

bill_title: Permits for Drilling, Exploration, and Extraction of Oil and Gas Resources
bill_desc: Prohibits drilling, exploration, or production of specified petroleum products within certain distance of national estuarine research reserves; requires DEP to consider certain factors when determining whether natural resources of certain bodies of water & shore areas are adequately protected from potential accident or blowout; provides requirements for balancing test to make such determination.

Provides that charter schools are eligible for Workforce Development Capitalization Incentive Grant Program; revises number of programs school districts & Florida College System institutions must offer money-back guarantees for through money-back guarantee program by specified date; requires such programs be reported to SBE; provides requirements for specified student eligibility criteria for tuition reimbursement under program; & revises reporting requirements.

bill_title: Country of Origin for Wild and Farm-Raised Fish
bill_desc: Provides requirements for sale of wild & farm-raised fish originating outside of U.S.; establishes Florida Wild Fish & Seafood Certification Program.

Provides penalty for certain vessels occupying waters of this state if FWCC officer or law enforcement agency finds that specified conditions exist; revises manner & timeframe for vessel owners or operators to demonstrate vessel's effective means of propulsion; requires FWCC to issue permit for long-term anchoring; provides penalty for long-term anchoring without permit; authorizes enforcement of certain noncriminal violations by citation; requires that vessel subject to specified number of violations within specified period be declared public nuisance; authorizes certain persons to relocate certain vessels; revises notice placed upon derelict vessel declared public nuisance provides prima facie evidence of ownership or control of derelict vessel; provides means of exonerating owner of vessel or derelict vessel of responsibility if such owner attempts to transfer ownership or control of such vessel; provides that owner of derelict vessel is exclusively responsible for all costs associated with relocation or disposal; prohibits person from dwelling or residing on derelict vessel; authorizes law enforcement officers to enforce such provisions.
Requires district school boards to provide classroom teachers with access to mental health services; provides requirements for such mental health services.

bill_title: Governmental Entity Access to and Use of Vendor Background Information
bill_desc: Authorizes DMS to grant governmental entities access to specified electronic systems regarding certain vendors; specifies uses for which state governmental entities may use such systems; authorizes governmental entities to make certain determinations if certain affidavits submitted as part of competitive solicitation are not true; specifies that determination that affidavit is not true or that vendor is not responsible or responsive does not constitute decision or intended decision subject to protest.

Provides public records exemption for electronic systems that provide background information on vendors seeking to do business with state; provides for future legislative review & repeal of exemption; provides statement of public necessity.

bill_title: Verification of Reemployment Assistance Benefit Eligibility
bill_desc: Revises circumstances under which Department of Commerce disqualifies claimants from reemployment assistance benefits; requires department to verify claimants' identities before paying benefits; requires department to cross-check certain information; requires department to maintain web page & e-mail address for specified purpose & to notify employers each year of web page & e-mail address; provides annual reporting requirements.

Renames Agriculture & Aquaculture Producers Natural Disaster Recovery Loan Program as Agriculture & Aquaculture Producers Emergency Loan Program; provides that loan funds from loan program may be used for labor costs & to reset & replant agriculture & aquaculture commodities; increases maximum loan amount applicant may receive during application period; authorizes certain applicants to receive supplemental loan; authorizes department to defer or waive loan payments; establishes Silviculture Emergency Recovery Program within department to administer grant program to assist certain timber land owners; requires that grants be used for certain purposes; requires that only timber land located on specified agricultural lands are eligible for program; requires Citrus Research & Development (CRDF) Foundation to work in coordination with department to provide support for certain activities; requires CRDF Foundation to direct & manage certain program; requires department to assist CRDF Foundation in execution of its duties.

bill_title: Removal of Altered Sexual Depictions Posted without Consent
bill_desc: Defines "covered platform"; requires covered platforms to establish process for removal of altered sexual depictions posted without consent of identifiable person; provides requirements for such process; requires notice; provides immunity for good faith compliance; prohibits unreasonable failure to comply; provides remedies; provides exceptions.

Revises requirements for applicants for certified recovery residence licenses; revises requirements relating to interim licenses issued by DCF; authorizes DCF to issue probationary license to existing licensed service provider; revises conditions under which DCF may deny, suspend, or revoke license of service provider; requires that Level IV certified recovery residence providers undergo recertification audit at certain interval; provides that recovery residence is deemed nontransient residential use of land for specified purpose; prohibits local law, ordinance, or regulation from prohibiting or regulating recovery residence in multifamily structure; authorizes municipality or county to deny establishment of certified Level IV recovery residence under certain circumstances; requires maintenance of patients' confidential records; provides personnel-to-resident ratio requirements; revises liability for licensed service providers; creates Substance Abuse & Recovery Residence Efficiency Committee within DCF; provides purpose & membership of committee; requires appointments to committee by specified date; provides duties of committee; requires committee to submit report to Governor & Legislature by specified date; provides for future legislative review & repeal.

bill_title: Mobile Cranes and Accessory Support Vehicles
bill_desc: Revises definition of "special mobile equipment"; authorizes DOT to issue special blanket permit for mobile crane operating on & off Interstate Highway System to tow certain motor vehicle; authorizes DOT to issue special blanket permit for mobile crane & accessory support vehicle of certain dimensions to travel on & off Interstate Highway System at all hours, subject to local restrictions; authorizes DOT to issue special blanket permit for mobile crane & accessory support vehicle exceeding certain weight limits to travel on & off Interstate Highway System.

bill_title: Mental Health Services for First Responders
bill_desc: Requires Division of State Fire Marshal to develop & implement statewide behavioral health access program to provide certain mental wellness services & resources to first responders; provides requirements for program; provides that first responders are not required to pay copayment for services & resources; provides training requirements for licensed professional counselors; requires program, by specified date, to develop specified plan & submit plan to Legislature.

Provides requirements for Commission on Ethics relating to prohibited expenditures by water management districts; requires quorum & affirmative vote of majority of members of governing board before any action may be taken by board; requires South Florida Water Management District to provide specified detailed report; prohibits water management district from using state funds for specified purpose; authorizes districts to levy ad valorem taxes on certain property; provides requirements for maximum total millage rate; provides requirements for South Florida Water Management District's & other water management district's budgets; requires water management district give preference to certain bids, proposals, or replies for certain capital improvement projects; provides requirements for construction bonds & competitive selection process; requires certain projects for Statewide Flooding & Sea Level Rise Resilience Plan be ranked on separate list; provides requirements for certain projects; restricts funding available to water management districts; authorizes department to issue certain loans; provides for repayment of such loan; provides penalty; requires department to create & maintain separate account in Resilient Florida Trust Fund for certain funds; provides requirements for revolving loan program.

bill_title: Statute of Limitations Period for Violations Involving Required Reports Concerning Children
bill_desc: Provides that limitations period for offenses concerning specified required reports concerning children does not begin to run until law enforcement agency is made aware of violation.

Specifies circumstances in which Attorney General has exclusive authority to represent certain interests relating to charitable trust having its principal place of administration in this state; prohibits certain public officers of another state from asserting such rights.

Revises provisions for release & use of mitigation bank credits; provides conditions for use of out-of-service-area mitigation credits by project applicants; provides methodology for determining award of such credits; requires mitigation banks to submit specified annual reports to DEP or WMD; requires DEP or WMD to submit specified annual reports to Legislature; requires certain WMDs, upon application by owner of parcel subject to conservation easement, to release conservation easement if specified conditions are met, including obtaining sufficient mitigation credits from mitigation bank; provides for valuation of property upon such release & specifies that land may be used for development consistent with certain zoning.

Provides that all employee organizations that are certified as bargaining agent, & not just those representing certain employees, may deduct dues & assessments from salaries of certain employees; removes provision requiring certain employee organizations to petition for recertification; provides applicability; requires certain employers to implement outdoor heat exposure safety program that has been approved by specified departments; specifies requirements for safety program; provides responsibilities for certain employers & employees; provides exceptions; requires specified annual training on heat illness & providing requirements for such training; requires DACS, in conjunction with DOH, to adopt specified rules; requires certain contracting agents to contribute funds to qualified benefit providers for benefit of workers; provides contribution amount; requires such contributions to be made within certain time period; provides requirements for such contributions; provides duties of qualified benefit providers; authorizes qualified benefit provider to use specified percentage of contributions for administrative functions; requires worker to select qualified benefit provider; authorizes worker to change his or her qualified benefit provider annually; requires contracting agents to provide certain information to its workers; provides requirements for organization to become qualified benefit provider; provides cause of action.

Prohibits DLA from entering into certain contracts until Attorney General makes specified written determination; requires Attorney General to request proposals from private attorneys after making such determination; provides that written determination does not constitute final agency action that is subject to review; requires contracted private attorneys to maintain certain records & to provide those records to DLA; requires DLA to post & maintain specified information on its website; requires Attorney General to submit annual report to Legislature.

Repeals provisions relating to application of Florida Motor Vehicle No-Fault Law; revises motor vehicle insurance coverages that applicant must show to register certain vehicles with DHSMV; revises garage liability insurance requirements for motor vehicle dealer license applicants; revises financial responsibility requirements for owners or lessees of for-hire passenger transportation vehicles; revises requirements for certificate of deposit that is required if person elects certain method of proving financial responsibility; revises minimum net worth requirements to qualify certain persons as self-insurers; revises coverages that must provide premium charge reduction; revises coverages that are subject to premium discounts for specified motor vehicle equipment; revises coverages that are subject to stacking prohibition; revises coverages of motor vehicle insurance policy for which licensed general lines agent may charge specified fee; revises additional liability insurance requirements for commercial motor vehicles; revises insurance requirements for transportation network company drivers; revises coverages in policy sold in combination with accidental death & dismemberment policy which premium finance company may not finance.

Provides county, municipality, other political subdivision of state, covered entity, or third-party agent that complies with certain requirements is not liable in connection with cybersecurity incident; requires covered entities & third-party agents to implement revised frameworks, standards, laws, or regulations within specified time period; provides private cause of action is not established; provides certain failures are not evidence of negligence, do not constitute negligence per se, & cannot be used as evidence of fault; specifies defendant in certain actions has certain burden of proof.

Provides for equal employment opportunity; prohibits discrimination in employment; prohibits executive agencies from engaging in certain employment practices; authorizes certain persons to file complaint with Attorney General or Department of Business of Professional Regulation; provides for competitive procurement of claims review services for state group health insurance plans; revises exempt positions that are not covered by career service system; revises recruitment provisions relating to career service system; revises personnel rules of DMS; revises specified benefits of law enforcement officers & firefighters, respectively; revises powers & duties of Board of Governors; revises provisions relating to advertising & awarding contracts.

Requires all utility systems to establish & maintain comprehensive condition assessment program; provides requirements for such program; provides for enforcement & compliance; requires utility systems to annually submit specified reports to DEP; provides for funding.

bill_title: Elections of County Commissioners, District School Board Members, and District School Superintendents
bill_desc: Establishes county commissioner districts based on population of county; requires county commissioners to be nominated & elected by qualified electors who reside in same county commissioner district as commissioner; requires membership of board of county commissioners to be based on certain population criteria for each county; requires commissioners to be elected at specified time & terms to be staggered; revises membership of district school boards; requires membership to be based on certain population criteria for each county; requires membership to be identical to that of board of county commissioners; requires members of district school board to be elected by qualified electors who reside in same school district as member; revises provisions relating to election & term of office for district school superintendents.

Revises definitions of terms "harm" & "neglect of child" for purposes of child protection & criminal child abuse & neglect provisions, respectively, to revise required standards for supervision of children & specify that certain activities are not restricted.
Prohibits local government from adopting or enforcing certain regulations relating to guaranteed income programs; provides powers & duties of Attorney General.

Requires hospitals or hospital-based off-campus emergency departments to test for fentanyl in urine test & perform confirmation test if urine test results are positive for fentanyl; requires specified results to be retained as part of patient's clinical record for certain timeframe.

Requires each district school board to ensure that certain emergency action plans are effective & school personnel & employees & contracted personnel of before-school & after-school programs receive certain training relating to allergic reactions & anaphylaxis.
Prohibits state or local governmental entities from applying for or approving permits for specified solid waste facilities.
Prohibits cell manufacturers or marketers from selling consumer or nonconsumer products powered by medium-format, portable, lithium, or primary batteries unless specified requirements are met.

Revises provisions relating to elections including election systems, election security, reconciliation, vote-by-mail, poll watchers, hotline, canvassing of votes, audits, ballots, identification, eligibility, secure ballot intake stations, early voting, & election crimes.

Revises provisions relating to amendments to State Constitution including initiative petitions; handling petitions; sponsor & petition circulator registration; signature verification procedures; signature revocation; record retention; duties & responsibilities of supervisors of elections, Division of Elections, & DOS; Financial Impact Estimating Conference; certification of elections involving constitutional amendments; public funding; & criminal penalties.

Expands programs & diversion initiatives supported by implementation or expansion grants to include training for 911 public safety telecommunicators & emergency medical technicians for certain purposes & to include veterans treatment court programs; exempts certain fiscally constrained counties from local match requirements for specified grants; encourages communities to apply for specified grants to establish pretrial felony mental health diversion programs; provides model process for such mental health diversion programs; authorizes specified entities to collaborate to establish certain policies & procedures & to develop certain consent form; requires mental health evaluations & following of all recommendations as conditions of probation for specified defendants; creates Florida Behavioral Health Care Data Repository within Northwest Regional Data Center; requires data center to develop specified plan & submit annual report.

Removes language authorizing owner of agricultural enclave to apply for comprehensive plan amendment; authorizes such owner to instead apply for administrative approval of development regardless of future land use designations or comprehensive plan conflicts; removes certain presumption of urban sprawl; requires that authorized development be treated as conforming use; requires supermajority vote for adoption of certain comprehensive plans & plan amendments; authorizes owners of property subject to comprehensive plan amendment & persons applying for comprehensive plan amendments to file civil actions for relief; requires that local land development regulations establish by specified date minimum lot sizes within certain zoning districts to accommodate authorized maximum density; requires approval of infill residential development applications; requires treatment of certain developments as conforming use; specifies that certain parcels may be subject to recreational covenant & that certain recreational facilities & amenities are not part of common area; prohibits imposition or collection of amenity dues except as provided in recreational covenant; requires that recreational covenant recorded before certain date comply with specified requirements to remain valid & effective; limits annual increases in amenity fees & amenity expenses; prohibits recreational covenant from requiring association to collect amenity dues; requires specified disclosure summary for contracts for sale of certain parcels.

Includes additional personnel in provisions relating to peer support for first responders; prohibits discrimination in employment of first responders; provides that prohibited discrimination may be inferred solely from disparate impact of employment decisions or practices on members of group; establishes Counterterrorism/Counterintelligence Unit within FDLE; requires consolidation of certain 911 dispatch systems in counties under sheriff; permits sheriffs to opt out of such consolidation; provides requirements for consolidated systems; requires FDLE to negotiate & establish preferred price list for certain equipment; requires 911 call center to dispatch unit closest to emergency regardless of jurisdiction; requires agency to sign certain memorandum of understanding by specified date; revises requirements for reporting of missing persons information; requires certain basic skills training in resilience for law enforcement officers; creates Florida Medal of Valor & Florida Blue/Red Heart Medal; requires FDLE to study viability, necessity, & possibility of creating hurricane-hardened public safety operations centers; creates Florida Department of Public Safety Consolidation Task Force within FDLE for specified purpose; provides for membership; requires task force to prepare & submit report to certain persons by specified date; requires task force to establish Florida Department of Public Safety.

bill_title: K-12 School Route Optimization Pilot Program
bill_desc: Creates K-12 school route optimization pilot program in specified county school districts; provides program requirements; provides reporting requirements; requires DOE to assist school districts with implementation of pilot program; provides for expiration of program.

Proposes amendment to State Constitution to authorize Legislature to exempt tangible personal property located on land classified agricultural, used in the production of agricultural products or for agritourism activities, and owned by the landowner or leaseholder of the agricultural land from ad valorem taxation.

Provides additional provisions that Public Employees Relations Commission may waive for certain employee organizations; revises requirements for certification, recertification, or decertification of employee organization; removes provisions relating to revocation of certification of employee organization; provides prohibitions on public employers, their agents or representatives, or any person acting on their behalf; authorizes certain actions by public employee upon agreement between public employer & bargaining agent; provides exceptions for certain bargaining units.

Provides that certain covered garden leave agreements are not restraint of trade or attempt to monopolize trade or commerce; requires court to enter preliminary injunction to stop covered employees, businesses, entities, or individuals if breach of covered garden leave agreement is alleged; provides that certain covered noncompete agreements are not restraint of trade or attempt to monopolize trade or commerce; requires court to enter preliminary injunction to stop covered employees, businesses, entities, or individuals if breach of covered noncompete agreement is alleged.
Requires specified taxes to be renewed by ordinance in specified manner; provides for expiration of specified ordinances; authorizes adoption of new ordinances.

Prohibits collection or sharing of student's covered information without written consent from parent or guardian; requires specified contracts, agreements, & written arrangements to include specified statement; requires school districts to publish specified portions of contracts, agreements, or written arrangements relating to collection or sharing of covered information; provides penalties for operators & interactive computer services that fail to meet specified requirements; requires DOE to publish specified information relating to operators & interactive computer services on its website within specified timeframe.

Removes certain employment restrictions for minors 16 & 17 years of age; revises age at which certain employment restrictions do not apply, unless otherwise required by federal law; revises exceptions to certain work restrictions; removes authority of DBPR to grant waiver of employment restrictions.

bill_title: Medicaid Enrollment for Permanently Disabled Individuals
bill_desc: Requires that certain Medicaid-eligible persons who receive specified Medicaid-covered services & who are permanently disabled be presumed eligible for continued Medicaid coverage during redetermination processes; requires AHCA to continue to make payments for such services; provides exceptions; requires the agency to seek modifications to federal authorization to establish lifetime benefits for such persons.

bill_title: Financing Qualifying Improvements to Residential Property
bill_desc: Revises method of collection of certain non-ad valorem assessment.

Prohibits contracts between certain physicians & health insurers & health maintenance organizations from specifying credit card payments to physicians as only acceptable method for payments; authorizes use of electronic funds transfers by health insurers & HMOs for payments to physicians; provides notification requirements; prohibits health insurers & HMOs from charging fees for automated clearinghouse transfers as claims payments to physicians; prohibits health insurers & HMOs from denying claims subsequently submitted by physicians for procedures that were included in prior authorizations.

Provides that certain activities are allowed on school grounds; authorizes that candidates may be invited to speak as candidates on school grounds if certain conditions are met; prohibits certain political activities on school grounds; prohibits certain employees from using e-mail, offices or time during work hours for political advocacy; provides criminal penalties.

bill_title: Gay and Transgender Panic Legal Defenses
bill_desc: Prohibits individuals from using nonviolent sexual advance or specified perceptions or beliefs about another individual as defense to criminal offense, to excuse or justify conduct of an individual who commits criminal offense, or to mitigate severity of criminal offense.

Requires public schools to designate member of administrative personnel to provide annual training regarding human trafficking awareness to specified employees; requires employees who receive such training to submit acknowledgment to school; requires schools to keep acknowledgments filed electronically; requires each school district to provide curriculum for such training & to submit such curriculum to DOE for approval; provides requirements for training.

Authorizes PSC to establish experimental mechanism that meets certain requirements to facilitate certain energy infrastructure investment in gas & to make certain determinations; require PSC to adopt rules.
Revising provisions related to Florida is for Veterans, Inc., Veterans Employment & Training Services Program, grants, filing & license fees for veterans, & veteran courts.

Specifies functions & activities of Florida Museum of Black History; provides for legislative designation of permanent & temporary locations of museum; requires specified nonprofit organization to create exhibits for temporary museum; establishes governing board for certain purposes; provides requirements for governing board; requires governing board to submit written report to Governor & Legislature by specified date; requires DOS to provide certain support; provides appropriations.

Establishes Hunger-Free Campus Pilot Program within DACS; provides requirements for pilot program; requires OPPAGA to conduct study to evaluate food insecurity on campuses of Florida College System institutions & state universities.

Authorizes minor under 18 years of age to be organ & tissue donor with informed parental consent; requires DHSMV to provide certain education on organ & tissue donation to donor at specified time; revises criteria of web-based donor registry.

Revises provisions related to elections including qualifications; legal challenges to qualifications; use of political party names, symbols, & abbreviations; secure ballot intake stations; political party executive committees; & voter guides.
Revises examination & disclosure requirements for home inspectors; requires home inspectors to maintain errors & omissions insurance policy in specified amount.

Authorizes certain special districts to jointly enter into, participate in, establish, or control specified joint relationships or collaborations if certain determination is made by such districts; authorizes such districts to exercise such powers regardless of certain consequences as result of exercising such power.

Revises provisions relating to critical teacher shortage areas, Interstate Compact on Educational Opportunity for Military Children, Florida School for Competitive Academics, use of certain educational funds, emergency opioid antagonists, corporal punishment, background screening requirements for private schools, prekindergarten programs, students of military families, K-12 courses, instruction, standards, & bencharks, New Worlds Tutoring Program, & educator certifications.

bill_title: Property Tax Benefits for Certain Residential Properties Subject to a Long-term Lease
bill_desc: Proposes amendments to State Constitution to authorize Legislature to provide two $25,000 exemptions & assessment limitation to certain real property subject to long-term lease.

bill_title: Property Tax Exemption and Assessment Limitation on Long-term Leased Property
bill_desc: Provides that property that receives certain tax exemption shall be assessed in specified manner; requires property that no longer meets eligibility requirements to be assessed in alternative manner; requires submission of application containing specified information before receiving specified tax exemption; provides specified tax exemptions to property that meets certain eligibility requirements.
Revises requirements for one-half credit in personal financial literacy to include specified instruction.

bill_title: Election of County Commissioners and Superintendent of Schools
bill_desc: Proposes an amendment to the State Constitution to require the membership composition of a board of county commissioners to be based on population, to require county commissioners to be elected by qualified electors who reside in same county commission district as commissioner, & to require superintendent of schools to be elected.

bill_title: Elections of County Commissioners, District School Board Members, and District School Superintendents
bill_desc: Establishes county commissioner districts based on population of county; requires county commissioners to be nominated & elected by qualified electors who reside in same county commissioner district as commissioner; requires membership of board of county commissioners to be based on certain population criteria for each county; requires commissioners to be elected at specified time & terms to be staggered; revises membership of district school boards; requires membership to be based on certain population criteria for each county; requires membership to be identical to that of board of county commissioners; requires members of district school board to be elected by qualified electors who reside in same school district as member; revises provisions relating to election & term of office for district school superintendents.

Revises definition of "persistently low-performing school"; authorizes certain entities to directly report their students to DOE; provides requirements for schools of hope to use school district educational facilities; authorizes schools of hope to use certain facilities or co-locate with other public schools in certain facilities; requires certain students to be included in specified school district calculations; requires specified services to be provided to schools of hope at no cost; provides school district requirements; removes definition of "underused, vacant, or surplus facility"; provides requirements for specified disputes relating to certain mutual management agreements.

Provides requirements for end-of-life of propulsion batteries; prohibits disposal of specified batteries by landfilling; provides requirements for solid waste collectors & facilities; provides responsibilities for certain persons & entities; requires specified annual reports; provides rulemaking authority to DEP.

Prohibits campaign-related telephone calls & text messages to specified voters; requires candidates & other persons or organizations to cease immediately all communications with certain voters; authorizes voter to bring certain action in court of competent jurisdiction.

bill_title: Autism Spectrum Disorder Training for Law Enforcement Officers
bill_desc: Requires Criminal Justice Standards & Training Commission, rather than FDLE, to establish an employment training component relating to individuals with autism spectrum disorder; provides requirements for training.

Provides for enforcement of safety measures at railroad-highway grade crossings through use of railroad traffic infraction detector; provides for enforcement of speed limit in work zone area through use of speed detection system; provides for designation of traffic infraction enforcement officer to issue uniform traffic citations; provides notice requirements; provides penalties; provides for hearings.

Provides that applicants for retail tobacco products dealer permits consent to inspection & search without warrant; authorizes Division of Alcoholic Beverages & Tobacco of DBPR to assess specified fines & certain penalties for each violation involving sale of certain single-use nicotine dispensing devices or advertising, promoting, or displaying for sale such devices; restricts advertising, promoting, & displaying for sale certain single-use nicotine dispensing devices by retail nicotine products dealers in certain instances; authorizes advertising, promoting, & displaying for sale certain single-use nicotine dispensing devices by retail nicotine products dealers in certain instances; provides restrictions on locations for specified dealers of nicotine products; requires dealers to submit application to division for conditional use or legally recognized nonconforming use in specified circumstances; requires dealers to relocate following approval of such applications within specified period of time.

Authorizes county to require proof that certain borrowers are lawfully present in United States; prohibits state & local governmental entities & private corporations from providing down payment assistance to person who is not lawfully in United States; requires immediate repayment of downpayment assistance & initiation of foreclosure proceedings; restricts eligibility for Florida Homeownership Assistance Program & Florida Hometown Hero Program, respectively, to persons who are lawfully present in United States; requires that all private employers, rather than only those employing specified number or more of employees, use E-Verify system to verify new employee's employment eligibility; prohibits money services business' licensees from initiating foreign remittance transfers unless they have verified that sender is not unauthorized alien.

Revises provisions relating to duties & responsibilities of & entities regulated by DFS & CFO, including compensation, payments, financial management & accounting programs, public depositories, health care providers, Special Disabilities Trust Fund, stop-work orders, funeral homes, cemeteries, boilers, insurance agents, title insurance agencies, insurers, firefighting, insurance contracts, & bail bond agents.

bill_title: Capital Human Trafficking of Vulnerable Persons for Sexual Exploitation
bill_desc: Prohibits person 18 or older from knowingly engaging in human trafficking of vulnerable persons with specified knowledge or in reckless disregard of specified circumstances; requires state to give specified notice if it intends to seek death penalty; provides for death penalty proceedings; provides requirements for court order in support of life imprisonment or death sentence; provides for automatic review of sentences of death; specifies aggravating factors & mitigating circumstances; provides for victim impact evidence; provides for resentencing if provisions are found to be unconstitutional; authorizes state to appeal from sentence on specified grounds.

Defines "migrant vessel"; includes migrant vessels in provisions concerning relocation or removal of certain vessels; provides procedures for law enforcement officers concerning disposition of migrant vessels.

Requires district school boards to adopt policy to temporarily remove instructional personnel from classroom; revises offenses committed by certainly educational employees law enforcement must report to specified educational entities; requires instructional personnel & administrative personnel to self-report certain arrests & final judgements within specified time period.

bill_title: Joint Session for Purpose of Receiving Governor's Message
bill_desc: Provides that House of Representatives & Senate convene in Joint Session for purpose of receiving message from Governor.

bill_title: Pub. Rec./Florida Is For Veterans, Inc.
bill_desc: Provides exemption from public records requirements for specified materials & information received, generated, ascertained, or discovered by Florida Is For Veterans, Inc., while administering Veterans Florida Opportunity Program; provides for future legislative review & repeal of exemption; provides statement of public necessity.

Revises duties of Florida Digital Service; requires state CIO, in consultation with Secretary of Management Services, to designate state chief technology officer; requires state agency & local government to report ransomware & cybersecurity incidents within certain time periods; requires Cybersecurity Operations Center to provide notifications & reports; requires state agency head to annually designate chief information security officer; revises membership of Florida Cybersecurity Advisory Council.

Provides that certain deviations from construction projects are not considered construction defects; revises parties to be served written notice; requires claimants to describe with specificity location of known damages from alleged defective conditions; revises parts of property parties may inspect; requires claimants who accept offer to repair to provide offeror reasonable access to claimant's property; provides when certain claimants may or may not proceed with action against offeror; provides that if certain persons obtain required building permits, certificate of occupancy, & local government approval, project passes required inspections under Florida Building Code; requires certain claimants to agree to preaction mediation in writing; requires certain parties to deposit funds in escrow account for specified purpose; provides when funds may be distributed; requires parties to contract with licensed engineer or construction management firm for specified purpose; provides that any remaining funds in escrow account be released back to payor.
Revises health care practitioners who may only electronically transmit prescriptions for certain drugs; revises exceptions.

Revises provisions related to certain mandates, medical marijuana treatment centers, medical marijuana testing laboratories; Board of Orthotists & Prosthetists, & eligibility criteria for licensure by endorsement under MOBILE Act; prohibits health care provider or health care facility from discriminating against patient based solely on patient's vaccination status.

Authorizes Office of Statewide Prosecution to investigate & prosecute specified violations; revises provisions relating to false reports of abuse, abandonment, & neglect; requires DCF to enter into agreements with certain military installations for child protective investigations; authorizes law enforcement officer or authorized agent of department to take child into custody who is subject of specified court order; authorizes DCF or community-based care provider to petition court for specified order for immigrant children; provides requirements for natural persons, other entities, & the department relating to unaccompanied alien children; provides criminal penalties & civil fines; revises provisions relating to provisional certification for additional domestic violence centers; revises membership requirements for certain independent special districts; authorizes DCF to grant certain exemptions from disqualification for certain persons; requires DCF to establish fee schedule for daily room & board rates for certain children; authorizes DCF to extend certain license expiration date; provides that certain residential child-caring agencies are not subject to certain proximity requirements; provides that certain residential child-caring agencies are not required to install fire sprinklers or fire suppression system; specifies entity with jurisdiction for accepting missing child reports; authorizes law enforcement agencies to use reasonable force to take certain children into custody.

Revising provisions related to taxes & assessments including terminology, powers of governing bodies, administration, property appraisers, valuation, agricultural land, millage, state lands, delinquencies, collection, and interest.

bill_title: Intestate Succession Involving a Person Born Out of Wedlock
bill_desc: Revises circumstances used to determine intestate succession involving persons born out of wedlock
Revises provisions relating to DOE, FCS institutions, state universities, & K-20 education system.

Revises requirements relating to Just Read, Florida! Office, Florida Center for Reading Research, school district reading instruction plans, & school district professional learning system to include specified training & instruction related to reading interventions & instruction; & creates reading coach allocation.

bill_title: Licensing and Regulating Locksmith Services Businesses
bill_desc: Requires licensure of locksmith services businesses by DACS; requires fingerprinting & background screening for criminal history record checks of license applicants & certain persons ; authorizes licensure through endorsement & reciprocity agreements; provides for denial, suspension, revocation, or refusal to renew licenses; requires locksmith services business to maintain liability insurance; establishes qualifications & training requirements for locksmiths, automotive-only locksmiths, & apprentice locksmiths; requires locksmith services businesses to keep certain records & issue photo ID cards to locksmiths & apprentices; requires display of photo ID cards & licenses & display license numbers & business names in all advertising; authorizes review of records by law enforcement & DACS; prohibits persons from obtaining, owning, & possessing locksmith tools; preempts to state regulation of locksmith services, locksmiths, & locksmith services businesses; prohibits issuance or renewal of local business tax receipts to locksmith services businesses; creates Advisory Council within DACS.
Re-creates Resilient Florida Trust Fund within DEP.

Authorizes heavy equipment rental dealer to charge & collect specified recovery fee; requires heavy equipment rental dealer to retain recovery fee for specified purpose; prohibits recovery fee from being charged to certain entities; prohibits recovery fee from being included in any taxable sales price.

Requires counties & municipalities affected by emergency to provide specified information on their websites & through all means possible; provides that emergency contingency plan is public record & must be presented to Legislature in certain years; requires Secretary of State to consult with specified entities; provides voter rights with respect to participating in election in county that has been designated as being in state of emergency or eligible for individual or public assistance from Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA); requires Division of Elections to take certain actions if election is scheduled within certain timeframe after emergency; requires division to maintain certain number of strategic elections equipment reserves in certain areas of this state; authorizes division to contract with certain vendors for provision of reserve equipment; specifies certain equipment be included in reserve equipment; requires election officials to take certain actions if county has been designated as being in state of emergency or eligible for individual or public assistance; specifies that certain criminal penalties do not apply if county has been designated as being in state of emergency or eligible for individual or public assistance; prohibits supervisor from requiring certain voters to use certain uniform statewide application.

bill_title: Jurisdiction of the Public Service Commission Relating to Water and Wastewater Systems
bill_desc: Revises types of nonprofit organizations that are exempt from commission jurisdiction; provides procedure for commission to determine whether organization is qualifying nonprofit organization exempt from commission jurisdiction; provides standards for making such determinations; authorizes organization to petition commission to regain qualifying nonprofit organization status; requires specified waiting period before certain organizations may petition to regain qualifying nonprofit organization status; requires commission to adopt rules

Revises and provides provisions relating to Board of Governors financial disclosure requirements, reappointment of members of state board, chair of state board, reappointment of members of Florida College System institution boards of trustees, chairs of boards of trustees, Florida College System institutions, presidential search committees, Board of Governors requirements, presidents of state universities, appointed members of university boards of trustees, & supplemental textbooks & instructional materials; removes provisions relating to applicants for president of state university or Florida College System institution.

Removes ability of optician to delegate specified acts to unlicensed supportive personnel; removes exception to optician licensure requirements for employees working under direct supervision of physician or optometrist.

bill_title: Succession to Office of Governor, Auditing, and Government Efficiency
bill_desc: Proposes repeal of provisions in State Constitution relating to creation of office of Lieutenant Governor & Government Efficiency Task Force & amendments to State Constitution to revise provisions relating to auditing & government efficiency, create Office of Commissioner of Government Efficiency as Cabinet officer, revise provisions relating to succession to office of Governor if there is vacancy or in case of impeachment or incapacity, & submit to electorate, during specified election year, ballot question regarding whether to repeal office of Commissioner of Government Efficiency.

bill_title: Community Services for Needy Individuals and Families
bill_desc: Provides goals of Hope Florida; creates Hope Florida Office within EOG; provides duties of office; provides eligibility requirements for Hope Florida participants; specifies that Hope Florida is voluntary; specifies mechanisms by which individuals may receive assistance; requires office to designate state agency to perform certain functions; requires Hope Navigators to be embedded in communities for specified purposes; requires care plans to include certain steps & timelines; specifies duties of Hope Florida partner network; requires specified state agencies to participate in Hope Florida at direction of EOG; requires participating state agencies to use existing resources & personnel, if possible; authorizes other entities to participate in Hope Florida at direction of office.

Exempts from public records requirements certain personal identifying information provided to Hope Florida Office or Hope Navigators by participants; provides exceptions; requires persons who receive access to such information to maintain confidential & exempt status of such information; provides criminal penalties; provides for future legislative review & repeal of exemption.

bill_title: Tax Rebates for Low- to Moderate-income Residents
bill_desc: Creates the Working Floridians Tax Rebate Program within DOR; grants state funds to certain people who receive specified tax credit & meet certain criteria; prohibits receipt of rebate from being used in certain program eligibility determinations.

Authorizes certain actions by eligible facilities, manufacturers operating within eligible facilities, & eligible patients relating to individualized investigational treatments; authorizes health plans, third-party administrators, & governmental agencies to provide coverage for cost of individualized investigational drug, biological product, or device, or cost of certain services; limits liability; prohibits licensing boards, disciplinary subcommittees, & entities responsible for Medicare certification from taking certain actions against health care provider's license; prohibits certain persons from blocking or attempting to block eligible patient's access to individualized investigational drug, biological product, or device; provides construction.

Requires AHCA to establish provider reimbursement schedule & billing codes for specified medical services & procedures coding to cover biomarker testing; authorizes Medicaid program coverage of certain colorectal cancer tests; requires Medicaid managed care plans to cover certain colorectal cancer tests at certain level; requires agency to contract for cost-benefit analysis.

Revising provisions related to emergencies including powers, duties, responsibilities of & funding for DEM & political subdivisions, medical care, special needs registry & shelters, planning, reporting, transportation of essentials, debris management, alternate power sources.

bill_title: Assessment of Property Used for Residential Purposes
bill_desc: Prohibits consideration of increase in just value of property attributable to changes or improvements made to improve property's resistance to wind damage in determinations of assessed value of certain property.

Requires DOH, rather than applicable board, to adopt rules for certain requirements relating to identification & advertisement of licensure & qualifications of health care practitioners; prohibits use of specified titles & designations by health care practitioners not licensed as physicians or osteopathic physicians, as applicable, with exception; provides that use of such titles & designations constitutes unlicensed practice of medicine or osteopathic medicine, as applicable; authorizes DOH to pursue specified remedies for such violations; authorizes health care practitioners to use names & titles, & their corresponding designations & initials, authorized by their respective practice acts; specifies manner in which health care practitioners may represent their specialty practice areas; specifies titles & abbreviations certain health care practitioners may use.
Revises provisions relating to assessment & collection of fines for public nuisances; removes limit on total amount of fines that may be imposed on public nuisance.

Creates Public-private Partnership Authority within EOG for specified purpose; requires authority to choose certain projects to manage; creates Public-private Partnership Infrastructure Program; provides purpose of program; requires program to create fund from specified sources for specified purpose; requires program to create portfolio of certain projects; exempts projects that are part of program from certain laws; requires reporting and rulemaking.

Authorizes DOH to establish Florida Cancer Research Network; revises definitions; making grant funds available; provides requirements & criteria for grant fund applicants; provides criteria for awarding grant funds; provides data reporting requirements for health care providers; requires certain data for collection; provides requirements for collection of data; creates online repository for best practices on Florida Cancer Connect website; authorizes Cancer Connect Collaborative to oversee Florida Cancer Research Network; creates subcommittees; requires Cancer Connect Collaborative to annually submit specified report to Governor & Legislature; creates Cancer Connect Collaborative Incubator.

Requires DOH to adopt evidence-based parent education materials on dangers of abusive head trauma, including shaken baby syndrome; specifies requirements for parent education materials; specifies requirements for distribution of parent education materials; requires department to implement multi-year phase-in plan for distribution of parent education materials.

bill_title: Registration of Sexual Predators and Sexual Offenders
bill_desc: Revises reporting requirements for sexual predators; revises requirements for an online reporting system; revises verification requirements; revises reporting requirements for sexual offenders revising verification requirements.

Revises provisions relating to administrator management; removes requirement that certain home health agencies provide specified services; revises Excellence in Home Health Program criteria requirements.

Revises provisions related to court hearings related to mental health and substance abuse, guardian advocates, involuntary admissions, placements, treatment, & outpatient services, assessments of patients, access to patient records & data, & disclosure of certain patient data.

bill_title: Pub. Rec. and Meetings/Mental Health and Substance Abuse
bill_desc: Specifies that hearings relating to mental health & substance abuse, respectively, are confidential & closed to public; provides exceptions; exempts certain information from public records requirements; expands public records exemption to include certain petitions & applications; authorizes disclosure of certain confidential & exempt documents to certain service providers; authorizes courts to use respondent's name for certain purposes; revises applicability; provides for future legislative review & repeal of exemption; making technical changes; provides statements of public necessity.

Requires FDLE to create statewide database of transaction data electronically reported specified businesses; provides requirements for database; prohibits certain data transfers by third-party vendors; provides restrictions on use; provides requirements for data storage; provides penalties for violations.

Requires DVA, subject to appropriation, to expand programs connecting veterans & their families & survivors to certain services, benefits, & support; requires DVA to host public events for such purpose; requires report.
Authorizes person to request expedited services from DOS in specified manner.
Provides filing fees for expedited services; specifies manners in which expedited service fees may be paid; provides that expedited service fees are nonrefundable.
Revises provisions relating to school attendance.

bill_title: Agency Agreements Providing Financial Assistance to Special Districts
bill_desc: Authorizes certain special districts to include a specified provision within agency agreements.

bill_title: Law Enforcement Officers and Other Personnel
bill_desc: Prohibits person other than law enforcement officer from using specified device; provides exceptions; requires FHP to retain specified funds; prohibits specified funds from being deposited into General Revenue; requires mandatory minimum term of imprisonment for attempted murder in first degree committed against specified justice system personnel; provides Legislative findings concerning prosecution of false reporting of crimes; creates Critical Infrastructure Mapping Grant Program within FDLE; prohibits law enforcement agency from using artificial intelligence for specified purposes; specifies requirements for testing inmates for infectious diseases.

bill_title: Medical Coverage Assistance Program for Working Individuals with Disabilities
bill_desc: Requires AHCA to implement & administer Medicaid buy-in program for specified working individuals with disabilities; provides requirements for program; requires agency to seek by specified date federal approval through Medicaid waiver or state plan amendment as necessary to implement program; requires agency to implement & administer program upon receiving federal approval.

Specifies that courts must follow certain provisions when ordering sale of real or personal property unless use of other specified procedures is ordered; provides requirements for transparency in judicial sales and foreclosure sales; provides an alternate judicial sales procedure that may be used in certain circumstances.
Increases combined total amount of credits which may be granted to business enterprises during any calendar year.

bill_title: Cybersecurity Risks from Unmanned Aircraft Systems
bill_desc: Requires Florida Cybersecurity Advisory Council to specified risks & develop certain recommendations.

Revises provisions related to elections including signature matching, Office of Election Crimes & Security, online voter registration, oaths, citizenship, information sharing, voter records, addresses, eligibility, updating voter rolls, candidate qualifications, disclosures, special elections, identification, voter challenges, ballot canvassing, poll watchers, ballots, sample ballots, polling places, audits, notices, reporting, vote-by-mail, endorsements, canvassing boards, political parties, campaign financing, & criminal penalties.

Provides exemption from public records requirements for records containing certain information received from another state after entering into memorandum of understanding pertaining to voter registration records.

bill_title: Failure to Comply with Time-sharing Schedule
bill_desc: Provides civil cause of action for parent's failure or refusal to comply with court-ordered time-sharing schedule; provides affirmative defenses; provides for retroactivity.

Revises provisions for certain final orders issued by PERC & delivery of service; revises seal of PERC; requires employee organization, within specified timeframe, to revoke membership of, & cease collection of membership dues from, public employee; revises requirements for registration, registration renewal, certification, recertification, or decertification of employee organizations; removes provisions relating to revocation of certification of employee organizations; requires PERC or one of its designated agents to conduct investigation if challenge is filed; prohibits public employers, their agents or representatives, & any person acting on their behalf from taking certain actions; revises provisions relating to impasse; authorizes certain actions by public employees upon agreement between public employer & bargaining agent; provides exceptions for certain bargaining units; increases fines for certain violations.

Exempts from public records requirements written communications developed in preparation for, or preliminary to, issuance of any order by PERC or its designees; exempts from public records requirements personal identifying & location information of chair, commissioners, & hearing officers of PERC & personal identifying & location information of spouses & children of such personnel; provides for future legislative review & repeal of exemptions; provides statements of public necessity.

Requires providers to register with FSC; provides registration requirements; requires provider to display its registration certificate; provides for renewal of such certificate; provides requirements with which provider must comply; specifies mechanisms by which registrations may be denied, not renewed, or revoked; requires commission to deny, refuse to renew, or revoke registration certificate; provides requirements with which provider must comply; prohibits certain acts by provider; provides administrative penalties; requires commission, by date certain, to prescribe form & content of application for registration; authorizes person who previously provided earned wage access services to continue for specified time without registering under certain conditions.

Provides that certain health care practitioners under contract with nurse registry are deemed independent contractors for purposes of provider reimbursements under Medicaid program; provides that such practitioners are not eligible for overtime or holiday pay.

Prohibits engaging in specified acts of animal cruelty in presence of child or causing or enticing child to engage in such acts; increases offense severity ranking of offense of fighting or bating animals.

Authorizes Secretary of Transportation to appoint certain officers; revises provisions relating to FTC; creates Florida Transportation Research Institute & Florida Transportation Academy & provides functions & requirements for each; revises provisions relating to project funding & funding prioritization, DOT responsibilities, Florida Seaport Transportation & Economic Development Council, commercial service airports, private airports of public interest, reporting requirements, advanced air mobility, performance & productivity measures, & permitting; removes provisions relating to social & economically disadvantaged business enterprises; authorizes DOT to require amount of certain bonds be less than certain amount; revises budgetary procedures for DOT; requires EOG to modify approved operating budget for fixed capital outlay expenditures; repeals provisions relating to high-occupancy-vehicle lanes, socially & economically disadvantaged business enterprises, penalties for false representation of such enterprises, contract awards to such enterprises, & electric vehicle charging stations & infrastructure plan development.

bill_title: Emergency Powers During a Declared Public Health Emergency
bill_desc: Revises requirements for declaration of public health emergency; provides exemptions for local municipalities; authorizes individual to refuse examination, testing, or treatment for specified reasons; prohibits such individual from being required to undergo examinations, testing, or treatment or to isolate at home or quarantine; provides requirements for at-home isolation or quarantine; prohibits public employees from knowingly & willfully taking actions that violate individual's constitutional rights during declared public health emergency; provides for disciplinary action & civil & criminal penalties; provides whistle-blower protections for public employees who report specified violations.
Requires that certain insurers' appraisal process make certain valuations to provide specified coverage.
Revises provisions relating to Chris Hixon, Coach Aaron Feis, and Coach Scott Beigel Guardian Program, school safety requirements, & safe-school officer requirements.

Retitles chapter 984, F.S.; creates & revises numerous provisions relating to juvenile justice, including provisions relating to early truancy intervention, appointment of counsel, and use of detention.

Authorizes certain patients, to determine, with assistance & guidance of their health care provider, individual courses of treatment; authorizes compounding pharmacies to access certain ingredients for compounding.

Revising provisions related to elections including elected positions, administration of election law & investigation of violations, voters rights, voter registration, vote-by-mail, ballot types, and Election Day holiday.

Provides for issuance of lifetime disabled parking permit to certain permanently disabled persons; authorizes certain certificates of disability to be older than 12 months for replacement of certain disabled parking permits.

bill_title: Florida Museum of History at the Town of Eatonville
bill_desc: Authorizes specified entities to enter into partnership to design, construct, & operate & manage Florida Museum of History at Town of Eatonville; specifies museum requirements; specifies duties of advisory board; specifies membership of advisory board; specifies duties of partnership & governing board of Florida Museum of History at Town of Eatonville related to museum; requires governing board to make certain recommendations regarding educational materials for museum; specifies duties of operating board of directors; requires governing board, in conjunction with Florida Tourism Marketing Corporation & others, to develop & execute marketing plan to promote museum; specifies funding for construction operations of museum; requires creation of endowment; requires museum to receive program support from operating board of directors, appointed by governing board.

Defines "structural integrity reserve study"; requires condominium & cooperative associations that govern building of specified height to conduct structural integrity reserve study for specified purpose; provides that condominium & cooperative associations that govern building that does not meet such specified height requirement are not required to conduct structural integrity reserve study; authorizes certain condominium & cooperative associations to elect, by majority vote of unit owners, to waive or reduce reserve contributions.

bill_title: First in Your Family Florida Medical School Scholarship and Grant Program
bill_desc: Establishes First in Your Family Florida Medical School Scholarship & Grant Program within DOE for specified purposes; provides requirements for such program.

bill_title: Applicants for President of a State University or Florida College System Institution
bill_desc: Defines "final group of applicants."

bill_title: Improving Screening for and Treatment of Blood Clots
