bill_desc: Requires stroke registry to include blood clot & pulmonary embolism registry; requires certain facilities to report specified information to registry beginning on certain date; requires AHCA to submit specified information to Governor & Legislature; provides limitation on purpose of publication of information from registry; requires hospitals with emergency departments & ambulatory surgical centers to develop & implement policies & procedures & conduct training for rendering of appropriate medical attention for persons at risk of forming blood clots, pulmonary embolisms, or deep vein thromboses; revises requirements for certain annual inservice training for certified nursing assistants employed by nursing home facilities; revises training requirements for certain certified nursing assistants who may be delegated tasks in nursing home facilities; revises minimum standards for care of residents in assisted living facilities; revises requirements for core competency test for administrators of assisted living facilities.

bill_title: Flood Zone Disclosures for Dwelling Units
bill_desc: Requires landlords or persons authorized to enter into rental agreements on behalf of landlords to make specified disclosures relating to flood zones before commencement of tenancy; requires landlords to notify current tenants of change in dwelling unit's flood zone designation.

Requires that resale-restricted affordable housing be assessed under specified law; specifies that resale-restricted affordable housing is land-use regulation & subject to certain limitation; requires property appraiser to consider such limitation to arrive at just valuation; requires owners of resale-restricted affordable housing to submit specified application to property appraiser.

Creates Office of Rural Prosperity and provides duties; revises distributions from the documentary stamp tax revenues; revises criteria for determining which counties qualify as fiscally constrained counties for funding purposes; revises uses of additional funds provided to such counties; requiring the EDR and OPPAGA to provide report on rural communities to Legislature; requires certain state funds to develop specified activity plans; requires certain local counties to issue reports; creates Renaissance Grants Program and Public Infrastructure Smart Technology Grant Program; waiving certain financial match requirements for projects for certain rural communities; revising provisions addressing REDI; revising provisions concerning deployment of broadband in rural, unserved, or underserved counties; revising distributions of funds from State Transportation Trust Fund; creating the Florida Arterial Road Modernization Program to improve 2-lane arterial roads in rural communities; requiring the DOT to allocate additional funds to the Small County Road Assistance Program; creating multiple programs designed to assist rural communities, including telehealth.

Requires documentation supporting that financial considerations & payments to affiliates by reciprocal insurers are fair & reasonable; authorizes reciprocal insurers to require subscriber contributions; provides applicability of specialty insurer provisions & nonapplicability of continuing care provider requirements to bondholders; specifies circumstances under which continuing care providers may withdraw specified percentage of required minimum liquid reserve; provides that continuing care & continuing care at-home contracts are not subordinate to any secured claims & must be treated with higher priority over all other claims in event of receivership or liquidation proceedings against continuing care provider; requires each continuing care facility to have its own designated resident representative; provides requirements for providers who borrow or solicit funds from residents; prohibits persons from acting or holding themselves as management companies for continuing care retirement communities without certificate of authority; provides guidelines for commissioner to determine if provider or facility is insolvent or in imminent danger of becoming insolvent; requires office to record notices of lien against continuing care facilities' properties.

bill_title: Pub. Rec./Uniform Mitigation Verification Inspection Forms
bill_desc: Provides exemptions from public records requirements for insureds' uniform mitigation verification inspection forms & associated data entered into insurers' databases; provides for future legislative review & repeal of exemptions; provides statement of public necessity.

bill_title: Hurricane Mitigation Grants and Insurers' Regulations
bill_desc: Requires DFS to require that certain mitigation improvements be made as condition of reimbursing homeowner approved for My Safe Florida Home Program grant; increases surpluses required for certain insurers applying for their original certificates of authority & maintaining their certificates of authority, respectively; specifies prohibitions for persons who were officers or directors of insolvent insurer, officers or directors of managing general agent of insolvent insurer, attorneys in fact of insolvent reciprocal insurer, or officers or directors of attorney in fact of insolvent reciprocal insurer; requires OIR to prohibit insurers or reciprocal insurers from paying any compensation to certain persons for certain violations until violations are remedied.

Creates Office for New Americans in Department of Commerce; provides requirements for Office for New Americans; provides that discrimination based on person's immigration status is unlawful; revises provisions of law relating to driver licenses, licensing, E-Verify System, the practice of law, federal immigration detainers, law enforcement agencies, DNA samples, education, & reclassification of penalties based on a person's immigration status; removes provisions of law relating to hospital patient data collection, human smuggling, sanctuary policies, duties relating to immigration detainees, reimbursement of costs, & sentence of death for capital offense committed by unauthorized alien; prohibits law enforcement agencies or officers, sheriff's deputies, & federal immigration agencies from engaging in certain immigration enforcement activities within a specified distance of public or private schools, child care facilities, or religious institutions.

bill_title: Attorney Fees and Costs for Motor Vehicle Personal Injury Protection Benefits
bill_desc: Provides that prevailing parties in suits by health care providers for overdue medical benefits under motor vehicle personal injury protection policies are entitled to reasonable attorney fees & costs.

bill_title: Mental Health and Substance Use Disorders
bill_desc: Requires DCF to require certain providers to use specified assessment tool; revises minimum standards for mobile crisis response service; requires facilities to update treatment plans within specified timeframes; revises requirements for discharge planning regarding medications; requires DCF, in consultation with DOE, to conduct review biennially of school-based behavioral health access through telehealth; provides requirements for review; requires Criminal Justice, Mental Health, & Substance Abuse Technical Assistance Center at Louis de la Parte Florida Mental Health Institute at University of South Florida to disseminate certain evidence-based practices & best practices among grantees; defines "person-first language"; requires DCF, in consultation with AHCA, to conduct review every other year to identify needs regarding short-term residential treatment facilities & beds; revises assistance & services Louis de la Parte Florida Mental Health Institute is required to provide; revises requirements of Florida Center for Behavioral Health Workforce to promote behavioral health professions; revises plan components for mental health assistance programs.

bill_title: Continuing Education for Building Code Administrators and Inspectors
bill_desc: Provides that exemption from certain continuing education requirements does not apply to building code administrators & inspectors.

Expands exemption from public record for names of crime victims as well as documents or records that could locate or harass victim or victim's family; provides that certain records identifying law enforcement officers who become crime victims are confidential for limited periods of time; provides extension of time if certain procedures are followed; provides for future legislative review & repeal of exemption; provides statement of public necessity.

Requires certain public officers & employees to be United States citizens & residents of this state, and, for specified public officers & employees, to reside in certain county; defines "office" for purposes of s. 5(a), Art. II of State Constitution; defines "employment."

bill_title: Trespass at Large Scale Ticketed Events
bill_desc: Provides criminal penalties for trespass that occurs in restricted area at ticketed event where attendance exceeds specified number.

bill_title: Agency Contracting with Media Reliability and Bias Monitors
bill_desc: Prohibits agencies from entering into contracts with media reliability & bias monitors or providing support to media reliability & bias monitors; prohibits agencies from accepting bids on, proposals for, or replies to contract for contractual services for advertising & marketing services unless certain requirement is met; requires specified certification from contractors before agency may extend, renew, or otherwise modify existing contract for advertising & marketing services; defines "media reliability & bias monitor."

Revises requirements for enhanced penalty for second or subsequent conviction; prohibits violations with specified intent; provides statute of limitations periods for prosecution; provides for award of punitive damages in civil actions.

bill_title: Disclosure of Public Servants' Personal Information
bill_desc: Provides that certain public employees & officials may provide written notice to data broker to prevent disclosure of specified personal data concerning themselves & related persons; prohibits release of data after receipt of such notice; provides for actions against data broker for failure to comply.

bill_title: Sexual Offenses by Persons Previously Convicted of Sexual Offenses
bill_desc: Provides mandatory minimum sentences for specified sexual offenses when committed by persons who have previously committed specified sexual offenses; provides requirements for such sentences.

Revises requirements for Medicaid recipients to receive offer for enrollment for long-term care services; requires DOEA to maintain statewide pre-enrollment list for certain services; requires aging & disability resource center personnel to place individuals on certain lists; requires certain staff to administer rescreening under certain circumstances; revises purposes of DOEA to include providing direct services to elderly population; defines "functionally impaired elderly person"; revises certain subsidy payments to include food & nutritional supplements; provides purpose & legislative intent for Florida Alzheimer's Center of Excellence; provides powers & duties of center; provides eligibility requirements for services; provides requirements for Office of Public & Professional Guardians in conducting certain investigations; requires court to enter written order with specified information when waiving certain bond; revises powers & duties of guardian; authorizes clerk of court to disclose certain confidential information to DOEA; revises requirements for sale of any real or personal property by guardian.

Provides for wind & flood damage mitigation grants under My Safe Florida Home Program; provides requirements for eligibility & application for wind & flood mitigation inspections; requires DFS to contract with wind & flood certification entities to provide mitigation inspections; provides details for maximum state contribution to mitigation grants.

bill_title: Department of Business and Professional Regulation
bill_desc: Revises boards, commissions, & programs established in DBPR; revises general licensing provisions for individuals desiring to be licensed by department; creates auctioneers licensing program, employee leasing companies licensing program, barbers' licensing program, cosmetology licensing program, and professional geologists licensing program in department; revises Clay Ford Scholarship Program; requires department to adopt rules governing licensure, operation, & inspection of mobile barbershops; requires applicants desiring to be licensed as cosmetologist, or in any specialty practice within practice of cosmetology, to submit to department complete set of fingerprints; creates Board of Architecture & Landscape Architecture in department; revises meeting requirements of Construction Industry Licensing Board; prohibits operators of public lodging establishments from offering or charging hourly rates for temporary lodging or sleeping purposes & from offering or renting rooms on hourly basis or for less than one overnight stay.

Establishes Task Force on Diabetes Management; ; requires task force to develop certain criteria upon making certain determination; provides for membership & meetings of task force; authorizes State Surgeon General to reestablish task force; specifies procedures & duties if task force is reestablished; requires State Surgeon General to establish program under certain conditions by specified date; requires DOH to create & maintain website; requires federally qualified health centers or covered entities to make good faith effort to schedule appointments within specified timeline; authorizes pharmacist to prescribe & dispense 30-day supply of insulin drugs, glucagon drugs, diabetes devices, & diabetic ketoacidosis devices; prohibits pharmacist from requiring patients to pay more than certain amount for such drugs & devices; requires pharmacists to refer patient to federally qualified health center; requires department to provide certain notice to all pharmacists; requires health insurance policies & health maintenance contracts, respectively, to provide coverage for laboratory & diagnostic testing & screening for diabetes; prohibits health insurance policy & health maintenance contracts from exposing certain cost-sharing requirements; provides applicability; requires dispenser to report to electronic health recordkeeping system certain drugs & devices dispensed.

Requires AHCA to, within specified timeframe, seek federal approval as needed to provide coverage of continuous glucose monitors & related supplies as durable medical equipment benefit under Medicaid program; provides for reimbursement of such equipment; provides construction; requires AHCA to implement these changes upon receiving any necessary federal approval.

Revises contents of report by Florida Gaming Control Commission; prohibits certain employment for period before or during service with commission; revises when commission approval is needed for transfers of stock or other evidence of ownership of certain pari-mutuel permitholders; removes provisions requiring reissuance of escheated permits; prohibits betting on athletic contests with knowledge that results are prearranged or predetermined; revises criminal penalties for specified offenses; requires fantasy sports contests to meet specified requirements; prohibits certain offenses related to games of chance; prohibits trafficking in slot machines, devices, or parts thereof; prohibits transportation of specified numbers of persons or persons of certain ages for purpose of facilitating illegal gambling; preempts to state regulation of gaming, gambling, lotteries, or any activities described in specified provisions.
Requires DOH to create informational poster relating to treatment of sudden cardiac arrest & make such poster electronically available; provides requirements for such poster.

Creates Department of Housing & Tenant Rights; provides requirements for rental agreements; prohibits landlords from requiring prospective tenants to pay certain fees; revises & specifies grounds for termination of rental agreement; authorizes tenants, mobile home owners, mobile home tenants, & mobile home occupants who are defendants in eviction proceedings to file motion with court to have records of such proceedings sealed & to have their names substituted on progress docket; requires landlord to give tenants opportunity to purchase dwelling unit or premises; prohibits landlord from evicting tenant or terminating rental agreement because tenant or tenant's minor child is victim of actual or threatened domestic violence, dating violence, sexual violence, or stalking; prohibits purchase of single-family homes for specified purpose; authorizes civil investigations & actions; authorizes award of certain relief; authorizes local governments & special districts to adopt specified impact fee; authorizes municipalities to create community land bank programs; requires certain municipalities to develop & annually adopt community land bank plan; authorizes land banks to buy certain property for less than market value; requires land banks to offer qualified organizations right of first refusal to purchase certain property; provides that rental of certain homestead property does not constitute abandonment; creates Retail-to-residence Tax Credit Program & Affordable Housing Construction Loan Program.

bill_title: Voting Opportunities on Florida College System Institution and State University Campuses
bill_desc: Requires establishment of certain early voting sites; exempts such sites from certain parking requirements; requires establishment of certain polling places; requires campus Office of Public Policy to publicize certain voting opportunities in a specified manner.

bill_title: Pub Rec/Code Inspector Body Camera Recordings
bill_desc: Provides exemption from public records requirements for body camera recordings recorded by code inspector; provides exceptions; requires local government to retain body camera recordings for specified period; provides for retroactive application; provides for future legislative review & repeal of exemption; provides statement of public necessity.

bill_title: Enforcement of the Florida Building Code
bill_desc: Requires that local governments use certain excess funds from fees collected from enforcement of Florida Building Code to perform necessary services or repairs on their stormwater management systems; prohibits state funds from being used by local government for that purpose if local government has such excess funds; prohibits local governments from receiving state funds through local funding initiative; provides exception; provides that local government is not eligible for additional state funds if it has been subject to legislative committee's audit within specified timeframe or if it fails to submit affirmation to legislative delegation; requires each legislative committee to report such local governments to presiding officers & appropriations chairs.

Provides exemption from public records requirements for lethality assessment form that contains certain information & responses; provides for future legislative review & repeal of exemption; provides statement of public necessity.

Establishes presumption that breeding female dog is being used for breeding purposes unless certain conditions are met; requires dog breeder certificate of registration & dog breeding facility certificate of inspection; provides criteria for DACS to enter into cooperative agreements to conduct certain inspections; authorizes DACS to create risk-based inspection frequency system; requires DACS to create database on its website which contains certain information on dog breeders, dog breeding facilities, & retail establishments that sell dogs; requires DACS to create whistleblower program; requires dog breeders to microchip certain dogs; provides specifications relating to microchipping requirements & retail establishments; provides civil penalties; provides for enforcement; authorizes civil & criminal penalties.

Requires school grades to be included on student report cards; revises percentage of points used to designate school grades for specified school years; revises requirements for school report cards; & requires certain school grade designation to be included on school report cards for information purposes.

Repeals provisions, relating to definitions, tax on aviation fuel, refunds for certain air carriers, administration of tax, disclosure of price, distribution of proceeds, refunds to carriers, commercial air carrier registration & reporting, & tax exemption for federal entities, respectively.

Authorizes ambulance drivers to use red lights on privately owned vehicle in certain circumstances; expands exception to prohibition on using red lights to include ambulance drivers; authorizes ambulance drivers to use red warning signals in specified circumstances; revises restrictions on warning signals; authorizes ambulance drivers to use red lights on their personal vehicle in certain circumstances; expands exception of use of red lights on personal vehicle to include ambulance drivers; provides limitation as to when ambulance drivers can use certain warning signals; revises requirements for active first responder agencies to receive certain exemption; removes limitation on number of exemptions that may be granted.

Prohibits processors from manufacturing, delivering, holding or offering for sale, distributing, or selling finished kratom products that do not meet specified requirements; provides permitting, registration, & certification requirements for certain kratom processors; provides exceptions; specifies that processors assume responsibility & liability for specified kratom products; provides specifications regrading laboratories that certify kratom products; specifies prohibitions related to kratom products ; authorizes DACS to conduct third-party tests of kratom products under specified conditions; provides DACS authorities related to kratom products; provides administrative fine; provides appropriation.

Requires FDLE to impose fine for certain violations; authorizes FDLE to develop program to compensate certain residents; provides requirements to receive compensation; requires FDLE to develop rules; defines "unauthorized alien"; creates cause of action against certain local governmental entities & law enforcement agencies; requires plaintiff to prove certain elements by preponderance of evidence; provides that state waives sovereign immunity for liability in certain circumstances.
Expresses support of the House of Representatives to require National Council of State Boards of Nursing to produce & distribute NCLEX examination & test preparation materials in Spanish.

Specifies employment policy of state relating to person's sex; provides applicability; prohibits employees & contractors of certain employers from being required to use certain pronouns or requiring such employer to use pronoun that does not correspond to employee's or contractor's sex; prohibits certain forms from offering specified options relating to applicant's sex; prohibits adverse personnel action on basis of deeply held religious, moral, conscious-based, or biology-based beliefs; provides administrative & civil remedies; provides reasonable attorney fees & costs; provides that it is unlawful employment practice for certain employers to require certain training, instruction, or activity as condition of employment.

Creates Division of Labor Standards for specified purposes; designates division as state Agency for Workforce Innovation for purposes of implementing s. 24, Art. X of State Constitution; revises provisions relating to state minimum wage including, protected rights, prohibition on certain contracts, process for filing complaint, statute of limitations during investigation, liability & recordkeeping; creates the Division of Labor Standards Community Advisory Board; provides for membership, meetings & duties of board; requires annual report.
Provides that individuals have specified reproductive rights; prohibits local government from regulating individual's reproductive freedom.

bill_title: Availability of Marijuana for Adult Use
bill_desc: Provides requirements for cultivation, processing, retail, or transportation license of MMTC; authorizes department to adopt by rule additional requirements for permitting of cultivation, processing, dispensing, & storage facilities to ensure sanitary, safe, & secure cultivation, processing, dispensing, storage, & sale of marijuana; authorizes certain persons to purchase certain amounts of marijuana products, marijuana in form for smoking, & marijuana delivery devices; authorizes DACS to adopt rules regulating cultivation of marijuana by members of public for private use, including use of cooperative model for cultivation; provides retroactive application of certain convictions; authorizes certain persons to petition court to expunge criminal history record for specified convictions.

Requires manufacturers of tablets or smartphones to manufacture devices with filters enabled upon activation of device in this state; provides civil & criminal liability; authorizes Attorney General, parents, & guardians to bring certain actions; provides for damages & criminal penalties; increases criminal penalties for certain acts involving minors; revises definition of term "sexual offender".

Removes exceptions for certain parental rights; creates parental right to review & consent to survey or questionnaire provided to his or her minor child; creates parental right to grant permission for results or responses of such survey or questionnaire to be shared or distributed; revises exceptions for specified requirements of parental consent; prohibits use of biofeedback device on minor child without written permission from minor child's parent or guardian; defines "biofeedback device"; requires results of use of such device be provided to parent or guardian; requires that such results be held as confidential medical record.

bill_title: Medicaid Eligibility for Medical Assistance and Related Services
bill_desc: Extends Medicaid eligibility for specified low-income adults.

bill_title: Equal Rights for Men and Women
bill_desc: Ratifies proposed amendment to U.S. Constitution relating to equal rights for men & women.

Authorizes counties & municipalities to authorize & approve panelized construction on certain property; defines "panelized construction"; provides that panelized construction is considered open construction & is authorized under Florida Building Code & only subject to local permitting; provides that certain panelized construction is not considered dwelling unit for purposes of Florida Building Code; specifies manner in which panelized construction is approved; provides that panelized construction meets requirements of local product approval.

bill_title: Refund of Overpayments Made by Patients
bill_desc: Requires specified health care practitioners to refund to patient amount of overpayment within specified time frame; authorizes rulemaking.

Authorizes AG to call upon state attorney to appear before Cabinet for certain purpose; authorizes AG to receive cases from certain state attorneys; authorizes Governor to move cases to AG from state attorney for prosecution; provides that AG shall serve as permeant member & chair of JAC; expands required duties of commission; requires state attorneys to collect data on annual charges referred by law enforcement agencies for which case numbers were not assigned; requires DLA, by specified date, to develop schedule for auditing certain record.

bill_title: Civil Liability for the Wrongful Death of an Unborn Child
bill_desc: Prohibits right of action against mother for wrongful death of unborn child or against medical provider for lawful medical care provided in certain circumstances; authorizes parents of an unborn child to recover certain damages; prohibits recovery of certain damages if decedent is an unborn child.

Revises provisions related to prohibitions on investments & contracts to companies that boycott Israel to include certain institutions, organization, agencies, & governments; prohibits arts & cultural grants for entities that engage in boycotts or discrimination; provides penalties; revises provisions relating to prohibition on contracting with entities.

prohibits landlord from asking prospective tenant about criminal record prior to making conditional offer; limits offenses that may be considered after such an offer is made; removes full payment of financial obligations from voting rights restoration requirements; provides for retroactive applicability of sentencing & resentencing of certain persons who committed certain violations before specified date which involved trafficking in certain controlled substances; revises definitions of term "juvenile offender" for purposes of review of sentences of review of juvenile sentences; provides for treatment of concurrent & consecutive sentences; provides for retroactive effect; requires DOC to provide specified data concerning inmates to Legislature for redistricting purposes; specifies how such data shall be used in redistricting; provides that only persons convicted of capital or life felonies are liable for correctional costs in specified liquidated damage amount for incarceration; removes provisions specifying fixed daily amount for an offender's liability for incarceration costs; revises offenses for which juvenile may be direct filed in adult court; requires judicial finding for discretionary direct file of juveniles; provides requirements for judicial findings; provides for return of juveniles to juvenile division at any point during circuit court proceedings.

Requires certain public meetings as condition precedent to effectiveness of new or extended agreement under which municipality will provide specified utility services in other municipalities or unincorporated areas; limits portion of certain utility revenues that municipality may use to fund or finance general government functions; requires excess revenues to be reinvested into municipal utility or returned to customers; requires municipalities that provide specified utility services to report certain information by specified date to PSC on annual basis; requires PSC to compile certain information & submit report containing such information to Governor & Legislature by specified date; revises provisions relating to permissible rates, fees, & charges imposed by municipal water & sewer utilities on customers located outside municipal boundaries; prohibits boards, agencies, commissions, & authorities of any county, municipal corporation, or political subdivision from restricting or prohibiting fuel sources & appliances used to provide energy to consumers.

Prohibits impersonation of transportation network company driver; provides criminal penalties; provides that services purchased from transportation network company are not considered privately owned or operated bus transit systems; revises definition of "transportation service provider"; requires transportation service providers to provide certain drivers with access to certain training materials.

bill_title: Prohibitions Against Discriminatory Practices Relating to 340B Entities and 340B Drugs
bill_desc: Prohibits drug manufacturers from engaging in certain acts against acquisitions of 340B drugs by & delivery of such drugs to specified pharmacies; prohibits drug manufacturers from interfering with pharmacies' rights to contract with 340B entities; prohibits certain acts by health insurers, HMOs, pharmacy benefit managers, or other third-party payors, or their agents, relating to reimbursement to 340B entity for 340B drugs; provides that each commission of certain acts constitutes violation of Florida Deceptive & Unfair Trade Practices Act & subjects violator to certain penalties.

bill_title: Home Health Aide for Medically Fragile Children Program
bill_desc: Provides requirements for annual assessment of home health aide for medically fragile children program; revises program training requirements; revises utilization cap of Medicaid fee schedule; requires home health aide for medically fragile children who works more than 40 hours per week to provide specified justification; provides requirements for AHCA to seek federal approval & federal waiver for specified purposes.

bill_title: Emergency Preparedness for Life-sustaining Medical Services
bill_desc: Requires specified entities, plans, & programs to enact flexibilities & waivers during emergency; defines "emergency" & "life sustaining medical services"; specifies flexibilities & waivers such specified entities, plans, & programs must enact; provides when such flexibilities & waivers become effective; authorizes time period for such flexibilities & waivers to be extended by OIR or AHCA.

Authorizes sibling who is separated from his or her other siblings to file specified motion; provides standing; requires court to hold hearing, take evidence, & hear arguments if motion for sibling visitation or contact is contested; prohibits court from denying such motion unless certain circumstances exist; requires immediate provision of certain services; authorizes certain parties to appeal court order in specified manner; prohibits court from restricting sibling visitation or contact without need for motion; provides that court retains jurisdiction over dependent child in permanent guardianship for certain purposes relating to sibling visitation or contact; revises required response DCF or community-based care lead agency must provide to prospective adoptive parent; prohibits court from denying postadoption visitation or contact between siblings unless certain circumstances exist; requires immediate provision of certain services; specifying that certain factors must be considered for postadoption visitation or contact between adopted child & certain persons; provides that court retains jurisdiction over adopted child for certain purposes until child is specified age.

Revises provisions relating to emergencies including tenant rights, elections held after emergency, planning & preparedness for election emergencies, emergency management plans, training, government offices, National Flood Insurance Program participation, replacement structures, reporting, assessment of property, shelters, medical care, comprehensive plans, powers & duties of DEM, notification, financial assistance & funding, grant programs, contracts for emergency services, hurricane recovery, debris management, & hoisting equipment.

Defines "legal relative"; authorizes certain parties to enter into written contract for postadoption contact that permits contact between adopted child & his or her legal relatives; provides that certain contract provisions are unenforceable; requires that postadoption contract include certain statements; authorizes any party to such contract to file contract with court; requires court to make contract part of final adoption order; provides that continuing validity of adoption is not contingent upon compliance with terms of contract; authorizes & providing requirements for enforcement, modification, or termination of contract; prohibits enforcement of contract in certain circumstances; provides for automatic termination of contract in certain circumstances.

Revises definition of "harmful to minors" for purposes of laws restricting such materials; revises provisions concerning standards for instructional materials & challenges to such materials; requires State Board of Education to monitor district compliance with specified requirements; provides for sanctions on districts that fail to comply with specified requirements.

Specifies that certain provisions relating to homeowners' policies, offers of replacement cost coverage, & offers of law & ordinance coverage do not prohibit insurers from providing specified property insurance policies by including roof covering reimbursement schedules; provides requirements for roof covering reimbursement schedules; specifies that certain provisions relating to homeowners' policies, offers of replacement cost coverage, & offers of law & ordinance coverage do not prohibit insurers from providing specified property insurance policies by offering roof reimbursement on basis of replacement costs; specifies that certain provisions relating to homeowners' policies, offers of replacement cost coverage, & offers of law & ordinance coverage do not prohibit insurers from providing coverage on specified property insurance policies for roof that is limited to certain value; provides that stated value sublimit of coverage may not be applied to roof in certain circumstances.

bill_title: Controlling Interests in Health Care Licenses
bill_desc: Requires licensee to make reasonable efforts to ensure specified information about person or entity who possesses controlling interest; defines "controlling interest"; revises definition of term "foreign country of concern".

Establishes Consortium for Parkinson's Disease Research within University of South Florida; establishes Parkinson's Disease Research Board; requires board to direct operations of consortium; requires board to annually adopt plan for Parkinson's disease research; provides duties of consortium director; provides research requirements for plan; requires board to issue annual report to Governor & Legislature by specified date; provides appropriations.

bill_title: Pub. Rec./Parkinson's Disease Research Program Registry
bill_desc: Provides public records exemption for Parkinson's Disease Registry that provides background information on individuals served by Parkinson's Disease Research Program; provides for future legislative review & repeal of exemption; provides statement of public necessity.

Requires state financial institutions to pay semiannual assessment for specified time periods; requires that semiannual assessment be received by Office of Financial Regulation in specified manner & by specified dates; authorizes office to issue specified certificate; authorizes elected officer, director, or committee member of credit union to be reimbursed for certain expenses; revises timeframe for certain requirements by directors of proposed bank or trust company; revises timeframe within which bank or trust company corporation is required to open & conduct specified business.

bill_title: Attorney Fee Awards in Insurance Actions
bill_desc: Requires court to award attorney fees to prevailing parties in civil actions brought against surplus lines insurers & insurers by named or omnibus insureds or named beneficiaries; provides guidelines to determine prevailing parties; provides applicability of prevailing party attorney fee provision to specified insurers, insurance policies or coverage types, & rate standards & to claims presented to specified guaranty associations.
Requires DOH to include uterine fibroids in a specified list of diseases.

Requires surplus lines insurers to comply with valued policy law; requires insurers' decisions to deny claims to be reviewed, approved, & signed off by qualified human professionals; prohibits artificial intelligence, machine learning algorithms, & automated systems from serving as basis for denying claims; requires insurers to maintain certain records of human review process for denied claims; requires insurers to include certain information in denial communications to claimants; authorizes OIR to audit claim denials.

Defines terms "central service technician" & "health care practitioner"; authorizes licensed hospitals & ambulatory surgical centers to employ or otherwise retain services of central service technician only if he or she meets specified criteria; requires central service technicians who do not meet specified criteria to obtain certain certification within specified timeframe as condition of continued employment; requires central service technicians to complete continuing education as condition of continued employment; requires hospitals & ambulatory surgical centers to, upon written request of central service technician, verify in writing technician's dates of employment or contract period with facility.

Expands actions subject to Florida Vexatious Litigant Law; revises eligibility for designation as vexatious litigant; revises sanctions & remedies for vexatious litigation; prohibits clerks of court from accepting certain filings from vexatious litigant; specifies duration of an automatic stay imposed against vexatious litigation.
Revises expedited state review process for adoption of comprehensive plan amendments.

bill_title: Parity for Nonnursing Services Under Long-term Managed Care Plans
bill_desc: Beginning on specified date, requiring AHCA to reimburse nonnursing services provided by licensed providers at same rate or higher than rate it reimburses unlicensed providers for such services under Medicaid long-term managed care program; requires agency annually to adjust rate for licensed providers; requires agency, within specified timeframe, to seek any Medicaid waiver or state plan amendment necessary to implement rate changes.
Revises provisions relating definition of childcare facility & FES & FTC programs.

bill_title: Insulin Administration by Direct Support Professionals and Relatives
bill_desc: Defines "direct-support professional"; authorizes direct-support professionals & relatives of clients in group home facilities for individuals with developmental disabilities to administer insulin as prescribed to client if specified conditions are met; provides group home facilities, direct-support professionals, & relatives of clients with immunity from civil liability for damages & civil & criminal penalties; authorizes unlicensed direct service provider to supervise self-administration of insulin & epinephrine through use of specified devices.

Provides exemption from public records requirements for matters in pleading, request for relief, or other document which has been stricken by court in noncriminal case if court makes specific findings; provides statement of public necessity.

bill_title: Official Actions of Local Governments with Respect to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion
bill_desc: Prohibits counties & municipalities, respectively, from taking official action as it relates to diversity, equity, & inclusion; provides penalty; authorizes cause of action against counties & municipalities, respectively, that take such action; defines "diversity, equity, & inclusion."

bill_title: Exceptions to the Limitation on Termination of Pregnancies
bill_desc: Revises definition of term "fatal fetal abnormality"; provides that one physician, rather than two physicians, must make specified medical determinations for purposes of specified medical exceptions to limitation on termination of pregnancies; revises criteria of specified medical exception.

Requires OPPAGA to conduct study of prevalence & effects of lead in drinking water in certain public facilities; specifies information to be included in study; requires OPPAGA to consult with interested entities in conducting study; requires OPPAGA to submit study to Governor & Legislature by specified date; requires DEP to consider & prioritize certain water quality improvement projects relating to special flood hazard areas; provides requirements for DOH, FWCC, & WMDs relating to harmful algal blooms; requires submission of plan relating to prevention & mitigation of harmful effects of blue-green algal blooms to certain entities by specified date; requires specified entities to provide schedule for implementing plan; requires DACS & SFWMD to take specified actions to ensure nitrogen levels continue to drop in Lake Okeechobee; requires DEP & SJRWMD to take specified actions relating to improving water quality in Upper St. Johns River Basin; provides reporting requirements.
Requires state to be granted an easement for ingress and egress to abandoned cemeteries on private property for specified purposes.

bill_title: Farming Community High-speed Broadband Development Incentives
bill_desc: Creates a state-funded grant program with Office of Broadband to fund broadband infrastructure projects in underserved farming communities; provides eligibility criteria; specifies limits on annual funding; requires funding recipients to providing annual reports containing specified information; requires office to conduct performance audits; authorizes farmers in underserved farming communities to receive specified tax credits if certain conditions are met; specifies projects eligible for tax credits; requires Office of Broadband to conduct specified public awareness campaigns & provide technical training programs.

Revises requirements for board of county commissioners salary formula to apply to noncharter counties; requires county population to be used to calculate group rate beginning on specified date; provides for determination of salaries of members of boards of county commissioners of certain counties; provides applicability relating to prohibition of supplemental compensation by certain counties; provides procedures for calculating salary adjustments for members of boards of county commissioners of certain counties; requires referendum for board of county commissioners to increase salary, retirement benefits, or other compensation paid to its members; requires referendum election costs to be paid by county; requires referendum for governing body of municipality to increase salary, retirement benefits, or other compensation paid to its members; requires referendum election costs to be paid by municipality; requires referendum for governing body of special district to increase salary, retirement benefits, or other compensation paid to its members; requires referendum election costs to be paid by special district.

Requires dog breeders to pay registration & renewal fees in amounts to be determined by DACS; provides limit on such fees; requires department to notify certificateholder of annual renewal fee by specified date.

Creates trust fund within DACS; provides purpose of trust fund & source of funds; requires that balance of trust fund remain in fund at end of year & be available for purposes of trust fund; provides for future review & termination or re-creation of trust fund.

Prohibits certain acts relating to sale & trade of enslaved individuals; provides exceptions; establishes specified penalties for violations of this act; granting DOS responsibility to oversee this act; granting Attorney General power to bring civil actions for violations; requires DOS to use existing state resources to fund this act; requires DOS to establish online reporting system for certain purpose.

Requires court reporter to transcribe certain proceedings or requires audio recording; provides that either party in dissolution of marriage proceeding may request jury trial; requires judge to make specific findings concerning certain allegations if party against whom allegations were made retains parental responsibility; creates pilot project in specified judicial circuit.

Provides that funds in First Responders Trust Fund may be used for grants to support first responder mental health; renames Emergency Medical Services Trust Fund as First Responders Trust Fund; revising the amount of fines for certain traffic violations to increase amount of funding for First Responders Trust Fund.

bill_title: Ownership of Single-family Residential Property by Business Entities
bill_desc: Prohibits certain business entities from purchasing, acquiring, or otherwise obtaining certain property & subsequently leasing or renting such property; specifies that certain sellers are not liable for certain violations; authorizes Attorney General to bring civil action; provides remedies.

Authorizes county to adopt ordinance requiring that certain solar facilities be properly decommissioned; authorizes county to presume that solar facility has reached end of its useful life; authorizes county to require certain financial assurance & certain updates from solar facility owner; authorizes county to take action to complete decommissioning of solar facility.

Provides requirements for the advertisement, distribution, & retail sale of hemp & hemp extract products; prohibits unpermitted business sales, street sales, or festival sales of hemp extract; prohibits businesses & food establishments from possessing hemp extract products that are attractive to children; prohibits business permitted to sell hemp or hemp extract from being located in certain areas; prohibits retail sale of THC-infused beverages at certain locations.

bill_title: Protection of Historic Monuments and Memorials
bill_desc: Prohibits certain acts concerning historic monuments & memorials on public property; provides for standing to bring civil actions; provides civil penalties for officials who engage in certain actions; provides local government is liable in certain instances; requires state to restore or relocate monument or memorial in certain circumstances; prohibits distribution of funding to local governments until they reimburse state; authorizes removal or temporary relocation of monument or memorial in certain instances provided certain requirements are met; specifies certain duties of Division of Historical Resources & Department of Veterans' Affairs.

Revises conditions under which employer may not take retaliatory personnel action against employee; requires employee to provide specified written notice to supervisor or employer; requires employee to provide employer reasonable opportunity to correct activity, policy, or practice; prohibits employee from recovering in specified actions unless employee took certain actions; requires employee to prove that employer's reasons for certain retaliatory personnel action are false; removes option for court to award other compensatory damages; requires, rather than authorizing, court to award attorney fees & costs; precluding certain claims.

Provides eligibility of all state residents for Florida Health Plan; authorizes plan enrollees to choose health care providers; authorizes enrollees to see health care specialists without referral; prohibits cost-sharing requirements from being imposed on enrollees; requires board to secure repeals & waivers of certain provisions of federal law; provides that plan's responsibility for providing health care is secondary to existing Federal Government programs; requires plan to collect health care costs from collateral sources under certain circumstance; prohibits eligibility for health care benefits from being impaired by defaults, underpayments, & late payments; requires Secretary of Health Care Administration to designate health planning regions; provides applicability of Code of Ethics for Public Officers & Employees; creates Conflict-of-Interest Committee, Ombudsman Office for Patient Advocacy, & position of plan auditor; provides that plan policies & procedures are exempt from Administrative Procedure Act; provides timeline for operation of plan; prohibits certain health insurance policies & contracts from being sold in this state on & after specified date.

bill_title: Trust Funds/Comprehensive Health Care for Residents
bill_desc: Creates Florida Health Fund for Florida Health Plan; provides for administration of fund; provides for sources of funds & purpose; requires claims for health care services to be made to fund; provides for disbursement from fund; provides for accounts in fund; prohibits funds from being commingled with other moneys; requires necessary waivers, exemptions, agreements, & legislation to be obtained for federal payments for fund; provides for future review & termination or re-creation of fund; provides that Florida Health Plan's responsibility for providing health care is secondary to existing Federal Government programs if funding for these programs is not transferred to fund; requires collateral sources to pay to fund; provides duties of Florida Health Board relating to fund; provides applicability of Code of Ethics for Public Officers & Employees to employees & director of fund; provides duties of plan auditor relating to fund; provides appropriation.

Requires, rather than authorizing, school districts to provide training in basic first aid to certain students; provides requirements for such training; requires each public school to develop plan for urgent life-saving emergencies (PULSE) for specified purposes; & provides requirements for school, staff, & defibrillator use & storage.
Prohibits local government or DEP, respectively, from issuing construction permit for certain new solid waste disposal facility or waste-to-energy facility in specified areas.
Creates rebuttable presumption that death of an alleged victim was result of controlled substance if substance was present.

bill_title: Prohibition of Considering Race or Ethnicity in Government Contracting
bill_desc: Prohibits awarding body from requesting documentation of or considering race or ethnicity when granting contracts or awards; prohibits awarding body from requiring or encouraging contractor or grantee to consider race or ethnicity when granting contracts, subcontracts, or awards; requires awarding body to submit notice of proposed rulemaking & adopt final rule within specified time periods; requires reduction of procurement goals by specified proportion; provides that certain laws, charter amendments, ordinances, resolutions, rules, regulations, & policies adopted by this state or local government are prohibited & void.

Provides criminal penalties for persons who willfully or maliciously harass or cyberstalk specified justice system personnel; revises elements of an offense constituting aggravated stalking; revises conditions under which court may issue warrant for defendant's arrest.

Authorizes licensed health care providers to perform stem cell therapy; specifies requirements for stem cells that may be used by such providers; requires such providers to adhere to applicable current good manufacturing practices in performance of such therapies; requires health care providers to provide specified written notice to patients before performing any stem cell therapy; specifies requirements for written notice; provides advertisement requirements; requires health care providers to obtain written consent from patient or his or her representative before performing therapy; specifies requirements for consent form; provides applicability; provides for disciplinary action; requires DOH to adopt rules.

Prohibits public employer, private employer, or employment agency from engaging in certain activities relating to wages & salary; authorizes public employer, private employer, or employment agency to confirm prospective employee's wage or salary history under certain conditions; requires public employer, private employer, or employment agency to maintain certain records for specified time period; provides administrative, injunctive, & civil relief; provides civil penalties.

bill_title: Offenses Involving Firearms with Bump Stocks
bill_desc: Revises definition of term "machine gun" for purposes of firearm statutes.
Establishes Early Education Workforce Support Pilot Program within DOE; provides program requirements.

bill_title: Appointments to the Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission
bill_desc: Proposes amendment to State Constitution to revise appointments to Fish & Wildlife Conservation Commission.

Requires certain employers to establish & administer safety committee; provides requirements for committee; provides requirements for certain employers relating to quotas, notices, employee protections, recordkeeping, adverse personnel action, enforcement, inspections, & reporting.

bill_title: Ownership Interests of Licensed Alcoholic Beverage Vendors
bill_desc: Authorizes vendors licensed to sell alcoholic beverages at retail to have ownership interest in production of such beverages in certain instances.
Amends Lee County Home Rule Charter to provide requirements for single-member districts; requires referendum.
Urges Congress to establish a federal catastrophe risk pool spread the risk and reduce the cost of property insurance premiums.
Urges Congress to impel United States National Guard Bureau to examine resource allocations of Florida National Guard & allow increase in its force structure.

bill_title: Compensation for Health Care Services for Inmates in Martin County
bill_desc: Limits compensation to health care provider that provides medical services for inmate housed in Martin County detention center if provider does not have contract with county to provide such services; limits compensation to entity that provides emergency medical transportation services for inmate housed in Martin County detention center if entity does not have contract with county to provide such services.

bill_title: St. Augustine-St. Johns County Airport Authority, St. Johns County
bill_desc: Renames Northeast Florida Regional Airport.
Revises definition of term "building official."
Repeals provisions relating to rights of certain employees & appointees of Citrus County Sheriff.

bill_title: Broward County Narcotics and Dangerous Drug Intelligence and Enforcement Unit, Broward County
bill_desc: Repeals ch. 71-574, LOF, relating to Broward County Narcotics & Dangerous Drug Intelligence & Enforcement Unit.

Creates Bermont Drainage District in Charlotte County as public corporation; provides that all subsequent proceedings concerning district are ratified, confirmed, & approved; creates district's charter; provides district's status & boundaries; provides minimum charter requirements; provides applicability of specified laws to district.

bill_title: Central Broward Water Control District, Broward County
bill_desc: Revises manner in which district may levy taxes.

bill_title: North River Ranch Improvement Stewardship District, Manatee County
bill_desc: Revises district boundaries.

bill_title: Officers and Employees of North Springs Improvement District, Broward County
bill_desc: adds to charter of North Springs Improvement District, Broward County, prohibition for conflicting employment or contractual relationships.

Creates Duke Farm Stewardship District; establishes legal boundaries; provides for jurisdiction & charter; provides for membership, election, terms of office, & duties of governing board members; provides for meetings; provides for district treasurer, selection of public depository, & district budgets & financial reports; provides district powers; provides for bonds, borrowing, & trust agreements; provides for future ad valorem taxation & special assessments; provides requirements for termination, contraction, or expansion of district; specifies that certain district property is public; provides for referendum.
Provides additional career service position; provides promotional procedures; revises membership of career service appeals board; revises board responsibilities.

bill_title: Greater Naples Fire Rescue District; Collier County
bill_desc: Provides for election of commissioners district-wide; requires referendum.

Provides exception to general law; authorizes Division of Alcoholic Beverages & Tobacco of DBPR to issue special licenses or modify existing licenses for bona fide licensees operating within such entertainment district for sale of certain alcoholic beverages for consumption off premises; provides that special licenses or modifications of existing licenses are in addition to certain other authorized temporary permits; requires bona fide licensees to comply with all other statutory requirements.

bill_title: San Carlos Estates Water Control District, Lee County
bill_desc: Provides that San Carlos Estates Water Control District, independent special district, shall become dependent district of City of Bonita Springs; reenacting, amending, & repealing certain circuit court decree; provides for transition; provides that members of city council shall assume offices of board of supervisors of said district; provides boundaries; requires referendum.

Revises boundaries of the Lee County Mosquito Control District; repeals chapter 2001-335, Laws of Florida, relating to Fort Myers Beach Mosquito Control District; provides for merger of districts; transfers assets & liabilities of Fort Myers Beach Mosquito Control District to the Lee County Mosquito Control District; requires referendum.

bill_title: Downtown Development Authority of City of Fort Lauderdale, Broward County
bill_desc: Removes expiration date of Fort Lauderdale Downton Development Authority; provides for transfer of assets upon dissolution pursuant to law.

Provides nonapplicability of provisions on alcoholic beverage-related actions & activities to special alcoholic beverage licenses issued for premises that are located within identified areas of Broward County; provides nonapplicability of such provisions to actions & activities of other alcoholic entities in relation to special alcoholic beverage licenses & premises; defines specified areas of county to which such provisions do not apply.

Creates Corkscrew Grove Stewardship District; provides short title; provides legislative findings & intent; states legislative policy regarding creation of district; establishes compliance with minimum requirements for creation of independent special district; provides for creation & establishment of district; establishes legal boundaries of district; provides for jurisdiction & charter of district; provides for board of supervisors; provides for election, membership, terms, meetings, & duties of board members; provides method for transition of board from landowner control to control by resident electors of district; provides for district manager & district personnel; provides for district treasurer, selection of public depository, & district budgets & financial reports; provides general & special powers of district; provides for bonds; provides for borrowing; provides for future ad valorem taxation; provides for special assessments; provides for issuance of certificates of indebtedness; provides for tax liens; provides for competitive procurement; provides for fees & charges; provides for termination, contraction, expansion, or merger of district; provides for required notices to purchasers of residential units within district; specifies district public property; provides severability; provides for referendum.
Creates Waterlin Stewardship District; provides charter.

bill_title: City Pension Fund for Firefighters and Police Officers in the City of Tampa, Hillsborough County
bill_desc: Increases DROP participation from 5 years to 8 years; removes full scale contribution rate; revises, updates, & conforms terminology.

bill_title: Fort Pierce Farms Water Control District, St. Lucie County
bill_desc: Increases maximum annual maintenance tax; limits annual assessment rate increases; requires specified changes for annual maximum allowable maintenance taxes; requires referendum.

bill_title: North St. Lucie River Water Control District, St. Lucie County
bill_desc: Revises maintenance tax assessments by district & increases maximum annual maintenance tax levy; limits annual assessment rate increases to specified percentage; requires referendum.

bill_title: Pasco County Mosquito Control District, Pasco County
bill_desc: Provides applicability of laws on term limits for Pasco County Mosquito Control District board members; requires county commission to draw geographical subdistricts; provides qualifications for district board candidates & members.
Provides space & seating requirements for issuance of special alcoholic beverage licenses to event centers; provides exception to general law; provides boundaries.
Requires the clerk of the circuit court & comptroller to provide certain services for certain historic museums & parks; authorizes clerk to provide certain funding.
Provides Central Florida Tourism Oversight District is successor to Reedy Creek Improvement District; revises district boundaries.

Expands district to include areas of City of Orlando; revises legislative intent, definitions, legislative policy, creation & establishment, board of supervisors administrative duties, budgets reports & reviews, & district powers to include references to City of Orlando & Orange County; amends district's legal boundaries to include areas of City of Orlando; requires district governing board election procedures to involve officials from both counties; requires general obligation bond elections to occur in both counties; authorizes levy & collection of non-ad valorem maintenance taxes in both counties; provides for required notices to be published in both counties; requires referendum.

bill_title: West Villages Improvement District, Sarasota County
bill_desc: Revises board member election procedures.

bill_title: Framework for a Sovereign Wealth Fund
bill_desc: Urges Congress to establish framework for sovereign wealth fund for United States.

Transfers real property from Board of Trustees of Internal Improvement Trust Fund to City Commission of City of Auburndale; provides requirements for use & sale or disposition of real property; requires conveyance of real property by specified date.

bill_title: Special Beverage Licenses for Equestrian Sport Facilities in Marion County
bill_desc: Provides for issuance of special beverage licenses to certain equestrian sport facilities located in Marion County; authorizes package sales of alcoholic beverages for off-premises consumption & sales of alcoholic beverages for on-premises consumption under such licenses; provides for conditions & restrictions; provides for compliance with Beverage Law, with certain exceptions.
Urges Congress to institute homeowner's insurance reform.

bill_title: City of Coral Springs and City of Parkland, Broward County
bill_desc: Reduces & contracts from corporate limits of City of Coral Springs & enlarges & extends corporate limits of City of Parkland approximately 8.7 acres of land contiguous to corporate limits of City of Parkland; provides boundaries.

bill_title: Leon County Career Services Employment Act
bill_desc: Provides for permanent status; provides for suspension, demotion, & dismissal; authorizes sheriff to promote, demote, transfer, & determine disciplinary measures, including dismissal; provides for transition to new sheriff; authorizes sheriff to adopt such rules & regulations as are necessary; provides beginning date of employees; provides for severability.

Provides an exception to general law; limits compensation to health care provider that provides medical services for inmate housed in Leon County detention center if provider does not have contract with county to provide such services; limits compensation to entity that provides emergency medical transportation services for inmate housed in Leon County detention center if entity does not have contract with county to provide such services.

Creates Bocilla Islands Chain Conservation District; establishes district boundaries; restricts density of dwelling units; restricts commercial, industrial or multi-family use of land to those lands zoned for such uses prior to effective date of act; provides height limitations on all buildings & structures erected within district; restricts expansion of infrastructure; provides that act shall not repeal applicable local government comprehensive plans, state & local land development regulations, air & water quality, infrastructure, & conservation regulations; provides exemption; provides that act shall prevail where it is more restrictive than such regulations; provides severability; provides that any real property owner in district may enforce provisions of act by legal proceeding; provides that act shall be recorded in public records of Charlotte County.

bill_title: Town of White Springs, Hamilton County
bill_desc: Abolishes the municipality; transfers assets and legitimate liabilities.
Revises provisions relating to Education Estimating Conference, Family Empowerment Scholarship Program, Florida Tax Credit Scholarship Program, FEFP, & K-12 funding.

Revises name of certain subsystem used for financial management; requires replacement of certain warrants; deletes authority to make semimonthly salary payments; requires certain requests for records to be made to specified entity; requires agencies to pay interest from available appropriations.

Provides that Governor, Cabinet officers, & Legislature are permanent tenants of Capital Complex; prohibits certain space from being reduced or moved without express consent of tenants; provides Legislature with first right of refusal if additional vacant space becomes available; requires DMS to coordinate with & receive approval of certain tenants before planning or scheduling certain projects; requires department to consider Legislature's schedule, time constraints, & needs for projects that impact certain space; authorizes President of Senate & Speaker of House of Representatives to take certain actions in relation to certain spaces without approval by department; provides that President of Senate & Speaker of House of Representatives have direct control over utilities for certain spaces; requires department to consult with & receive approval from President of Senate or Speaker of House of Representatives, as appropriate, before including certain projects in specified report; requires department to solicit feedback on development of certain state-owned property from all permanent tenants of Capitol Center; prohibits certain parking spaces from being reduced or reassigned without express consent of Legislature; provides Legislature with first right of refusal if additional parking spaces become available.

Repeals provisions relating to Florida health care innovation; requires Cancer Connect Collaborative to annually develop, solicit input from specialty hospitals for children for, & submit to Governor & Legislature specified plan for Casey DeSantis Cancer Research Program; requires plan to include expansion of grant fund opportunities for specialty hospitals for children; requires specified report to include specified analyses of certain cancer mortality rates relating to pediatric cancer; removes provision providing that results of specified audit reports are dispositive; prohibits administrative costs for hospital directed payment program from being included in allowable expenses for managed care plan.
Revises number of circuit court judges & county court judges.
Requires certain collected tax to be subject to specified service charge; revises how remainder of certain tax is distributed.
Repeals provisions relating to establishment of recreational customary use of beaches.
Repeals provisions preempting the field of regulation of firearms & ammunition to Legislature, to exclusion of local jurisdictions.

bill_title: Statute of Repose for Actions by Condominium Associations
bill_desc: Removes statute of repose for certain actions.
Repeals provisions relating to pregnancy support and wellness services.

bill_title: State Preemption of the Regulation of Hoisting Equipment
bill_desc: Removes provisions preempting to the state the regulation of certain hoisting equipment.
Repeals provision authorizing certain entities & institutions to adopt, implement, or enforce specified policies by rule or executive order of Governor.
Repeals prohibition on bump-fire stocks.

bill_title: Limitation of Size of Individual Wine Containers
bill_desc: Revises an exception to the maximum allowable capacity for an individual container of wine sold in this state.

bill_title: Recovery of Damages for Medical Negligence Resulting in Death
bill_desc: Removes provision that precluded certain persons from recovering damages for medical negligence resulting in death.
Repeals state estate tax & references thereto.

bill_title: Tax Exemption on Sales of Bullion
bill_desc: Expands exemption from sales tax on sales of bullion; removes single transaction requirement; removes requirement for certain documentation.

bill_title: Auxiliary Containers, Wrappings, and Disposable Plastic Bags
bill_desc: Removes state preemption on regulation of certain auxiliary containers, wrappings, & disposable plastic bags.

bill_title: Restrictions on Firearms and Ammunition During Emergencies
bill_desc: Repeals provisions relating to specified automatic restrictions on firearms & ammunition during certain declared emergencies.
Removes an exception to allow adoption & humane disposal of stray cattle under certain conditions.

bill_title: Performance Measures and Standards of Special Districts
bill_desc: Repeals provisions relating to special districts & performance measures & standards.
Deletes provision requiring specified percentage of all tourist development tax revenues to be used to promote & advertise tourism.
Repeals provisions relating to the Labor Pool Act, including the short title; legislative intent; definitions; exclusions; duties & rights; remedies, damages, & costs; & application, respectively.
Prohibits governmental entities and educational institutions from adopting, implementing, or enforcing international health organizations' public health policies or guidelines without exception.

Removes provisions authorizing parents & residents to object to instructional materials, requirements for certain meetings of committees related to such objections, provisions authorizing Commissioner of Education to appoint special magistrate, & district school board reporting requirements relating to such objections.

bill_title: Marriage Between Persons of the Same Sex
bill_desc: Repeals provisions relating to marriages between persons of the same sex.

Removes chapter 2022-72, LOF, relating to unlawful employment practices, discrimination against students & employees, required instruction, instructional materials, professional development systems, & reproductive health & disease education.
Repeals provisions relating to establishment of recreational customary use of beaches.
Revises requirements to serve as lead agency.

Provides appropriation from State of Florida to compensate Sidney Holmes for wrongful incarceration; directs CFO to draw warrant payable directly to Sidney Holmes; requires CFO to pay directed funds without requiring Sidney Holmes to sign liability release; declares that Legislature does not waive certain defenses or increase state's limits of liability with respect to act; prohibits funds awarded from being used or paid for attorney or lobbying fees; requires Sidney Holmes to notify DLA upon filing certain civil actions; provides that certain benefits are void upon specified findings.

Provides for appropriation to compensate Mande Penney-Lemmon for injuries sustained as result of negligence of Sarasota County through its employee; provides limitation on compensation & payment of attorney fees.
Provides appropriation to compensate the estate for injuries & damages sustained by Mark LaGatta resulting from the negligence of DOT; provides limitation on compensation & payment of attorney fees.

Provides appropriation to compensate Robin Button for harms & losses sustained by Marcus Button as result of negligence of employee of Pasco County School Board; provides limitation on compensation & payment of attorney fees.
Provides for appropriation to compensate Patricia Ermini for injuries sustained as result of negligence of Lee County Sheriff's Office; provides limitation on payment of attorney fees.
Provides appropriation to compensate L.P. for injuries & damages sustained as result of negligence of DCF; provides limitation on compensation & payment of attorney fees.

bill_title: Relief/Kristen and Lia Mcintosh/Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services
bill_desc: Provides appropriation to compensate Kristen & Lia McIntosh for injuries & damages sustained as result of negligence of employee of DACS; provides limitation on payment of compensation & attorney fees.

bill_title: Relief/Michael Barnett/Department of Children and Families
bill_desc: Provides appropriation to compensate Mr. Barnett & R.B. for injuries & damages sustained; provides limitation on compensation & payment of attorney fees.

Provides for an appropriation to compensate Jose Correa for injuries sustained as result of negligence of an employee of Miami-Dade County; provides limitation on compensation & payment of certain fees.

bill_title: Relief/Estate of Peniel Janvier/City of Miami Beach
bill_desc: Provides for appropriation to compensate Estate of Peniel Janvier for damages sustained as result of negligence of City of Miami Beach; provides limitation on payment of compensation & attorney fees.

Provides for appropriation to compensate Jacob Rodgers for injuries sustained as result of negligence of employee of City of Gainesville; provides limitation on compensation & payment of attorney fees.

bill_title: Relief/Darline Angervil and J.R./South Broward Hospital District
bill_desc: Provides for relief of J.R. & Darline Angervil, individually & as parent & natural guardian of J.R., for injuries & damages sustained as result of negligence of South Broward Hospital District; provides appropriation to compensate Darline Angervil, individually & as parent & natural guardian of J.R., for injuries & damages sustained as result of negligence of South Broward Hospital District; provides limitation on compensation & payment of attorney fees.

bill_title: Relief/Eric Miles, Jr., and Jennifer Miles/South Broward Hospital District
bill_desc: Provides for appropriation to compensate Eric Miles, Jr., & Jennifer Miles for injuries & damages sustained by their son as result of negligence of South Broward Hospital District; provides limitation on compensation & payment of attorney fees.

Provides appropriation to compensate Maury Hernandez for injuries & damages sustained as consequence of DOC failures to enforce probation laws, regulations, & policies; provides legislative intent that certain liens be waived; provides limitation on payment of compensation & attorney fees.

Provides appropriation to Stephany Grullon, as parent & guardian of J.N., to compensate J.N. for injuries & damages she sustained as result of negligence of Hillsborough County in maintaining sidewalks & culvert systems; provides limitation on compensation & payment of certain fees & costs.
Provides appropriation to compensate H.H. for injuries & damages sustained as result of negligence of DCF; provides limitation on compensation & payment of certain fees & costs.

bill_title: Relief/Estate of M.N./Broward County Sheriff's Office
bill_desc: Provides for an appropriation to compensate estate for injuries sustained by M.N. & her subsequent death as result of negligence of Broward County Sheriff's Office; provides limitation on compensation & payment of attorney fees.

Provides appropriation to compensate L.E. for injuries & damages sustained as result of negligence of department; requires certain liens be waived & paid by state; provides limitation on compensation & payment of attorney fees.

bill_title: Relief/Estate of Danielle Maudsley/Department of Highway Safety and Motor Vehicles
bill_desc: Provides or relief of Estate of Danielle Maudsley; provides appropriation to compensate estate for Ms. Maudsley's death as result of alleged negligence of Trooper Daniel Cole & Florida Highway Patrol, division of DHSMV; providing a limitation on the payment of compensation & attorney fees.
